We are seeking a hands-on Senior BeyondTrust Engineer to support the implementation, administration, optimization, and day-to-day operations of the BeyondTrust Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform. The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise with BeyondTrust Password Safe (Secret Safe) and Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM), along with proven experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise-scale PAM solutions.

* Design, implement, and maintain Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM) policies.

* Assist with remediation of audit findings and control improvements.

* 5+ years of hands-on experience with BeyondTrust PAM solutions.
* 3+ years of direct experience administering BeyondTrust Password Safe (Secret Safe).
* 3+ years of direct experience implementing and supporting Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM).
* Proven experience implementing BeyondTrust solutions from planning through production deployment.
* Strong understanding of Privileged Access Management (PAM) concepts and best practices.
* Experience onboarding: Windows Servers, Linux/Unix Servers, Oracle Databases, SQL Server Databases, Network Devices, Service Accounts, Privileged Application Accounts.
* Experience with password rotation and account discovery.
* Experience configuring session management, monitoring, and auditing capabilities.
* Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
* Experience working in large enterprise environments.

title: Technical Account Engineer I
description:
**Technical Account Engineer - I**

Sumo Logic helps companies keep applications reliable and secure. Our Technical Account Engineers are the people who make sure customers actually get value out of the platform, and they are the first point of contact for a portfolio of named post-sales accounts.

**About the Role**

Around 70% of the role is technical, hands-on-keyboard work: guiding customers through complex use cases, untangling deployment problems and showing practitioners how to get more out of the platform. The other 30% is building the kind of trust that makes you the first person customers call, whether that’s an engineer stuck on a query or a security lead thinking about renewal.

Our playbooks and automated health signals will give you a strong baseline, but at this level you’ll go well beyond them. You’ll know your named customers’ environments well enough to spot problems before they do and find the next use case before they ask. You’ll also design tailored plans when the standard play doesn’t fit, and bring in Support, Product, Engineering or Sales when a situation calls for it. You’ll help shape the playbooks themselves, and support Associate TAEs as they grow into the role.

You’ll have real visibility internally, including with senior leadership, and a genuine say in how we serve these customers.

**What You Will Actually Do**

* **Own your named accounts technically.**
  Be the go-to technical lead for a portfolio of customers, and know their environments, priorities and risks inside out.
* **Get customers using the platform extensively.**
  Build new use cases, bring in new data sources, teach advanced features and work through hard problems with security, DevSecOps and observability teams.
* **Craft success plans that can be measured.**
  Understand what customers are trying to achieve, turn it into a technical plan, help them deliver it and expand it as the value shows up.
* **See trouble coming.**
  Combine automated usage signals with your own judgement to spot adoption or technical risk early. Then pull the account team together to turn a wobbly account into an advocate.
* **Run the cadence.**
  Lead health checks and contribute to Business Reviews, building credibility with practitioners, team leads and executive stakeholders.
* **Help the accounts grow.**
  Work with Sales on renewals and expansion in a way that’s good for the customer and delivers additional value.
* **Make the team better.**
  Feed customer insight back to Product and Engineering and improve our playbooks.

**Where and When**

* This role is based in Noida, India, and candidates must be located in Noida.
* Shifts are designed to overlap core Australia and New Zealand business hours.
* You’ll join the local team in our Noida office from time to time, typically once a fortnight.

**What You Will Bring**

* 5 to 6 years in a technical, customer-facing role such as technical account management, customer success engineering, professional services, solutions engineering, DevOps or SOC analysis.
* Real production experience across enterprise infrastructure: operating systems, virtualisation, databases, networking and security.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP).
* SQL or query language skills, and the ability to look at usage data, work out what’s really going on and act on it.
* A track record of owning multiple customer accounts and building relationships from practitioners to senior stakeholders.
* Comfort with ambiguity: if something is unclear, you go and find out rather than waiting to be told.
* A strong team player who collaborates across GTM functions and gets things done with no fuss.
* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (B.Tech/BE or equivalent).

**The Technical Stuff We Would Love to See**

* Experience with Observability or SIEM platforms (e.g. Splunk, Datadog, Elastic, Dynatrace, CrowdStrike, QRadar, Exabeam).
* A background in alerting and monitoring in security, operations or DevSecOps settings.
* Familiarity with security frameworks and how they apply across customers’ lifecycle.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes (Helm), OTel, Prometheus and API scripting.
* Proficiency in using AI tools to accelerate day-to-day work. Certifications such as AWS AI Practitioner or Microsoft AI Fundamentals are a plus.
* Hyperscaler certifications at Associate level or above.
* Sumo Logic experience is a big plus but not required.

title: Sr IO Engineering Consultant - SCCM or MECM Admin and MS Intune
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
As an I&O Engineering Consultant or Senior I O Engineering Consultant, you will deliver reliable and secure device management services in a Dual UEM environment built on Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM) and Microsoft Intune. You will own day-to-day endpoint engineering and operational outcomes such as OS and patch compliance, client health, vulnerability remediation, and endpoint configuration. The role is execution-focused with solid troubleshooting depth and disciplined ITSM practices utilizing both on-premise server infrastructure as well as cloud services through Microsoft Entra. As necessary, you will routinely participate in major incident bridges/war rooms, ensuring service restoration within agreed SLAs and contributing to measurable MTTR reduction. You will also contribute to AI adoption by proposing and piloting practical ideations (e.g., ticket triage assist, automated log parsing, runbook generation) to improve reliability, speed, and user experience, while adhering to organizational security, privacy, and data handling standards.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Patching, Vulnerability Remediation & Compliance

+ Operate software update and patching operations via SCCM (ADRs, maintenance windows, deployment schedules, compliance reporting) and coordinate exception handling
+ Track and improve patch compliance posture across the endpoint estate; identify and remediate non-compliant devices; support compliance dashboards and executive reporting
+ Drive client health compliance. Monitor and remediate endpoint SCCM/Intune client health, enrollment success, policy/app deployment success, and content distribution health

* Platform Engineering & Operations, Application Support

+ Administer SCCM components (collections, boundaries, deployments, content distribution, client health monitoring, reporting)
+ Administer Intune capabilities (enrollment, configuration profiles, compliance policies, app assignments, RBAC) and support coexistence with SCCM
+ Monitor platform health and availability: enrollment success, policy/app success rates, client health, content distribution health, and remediation backlogs
+ Drive device inventory accuracy and operational hygiene; perform routine health checks and standard validations

* Application Lifecycle, OS Servicing & Operations

+ Support SCCM OS deployment and servicing (OSD, Task Sequences, feature updates, in-place upgrades), driver/BIOS packaging coordination, and rollback plans
+ Execute post-deployment validation and remediation for failed installs, policy conflicts, and provisioning issues

* Troubleshooting, ITSM & War Rooms

+ Troubleshoot endpoint deployment and client issues using logs and diagnostics (e.g., AppEnforce/AppDiscovery, WUAHandler, CAS, CCMExec)
+ Work within ITSM processes (Incident/Problem/Change) including change documentation, risk assessment, and post-change validation
+ Participate in major incident war rooms/bridges; provide technical inputs, implement mitigations, and document restoration actions
+ Track and drive SLA adherence; contribute to MTTR reduction via faster triage, known error documentation, and repeat-incident prevention

* Automation & AI Adoption / Ideation

+ Create and maintain PowerShell-based operational automations (health checks, compliance reporting, remediation scripts)
+ Propose AI-assisted improvements (e.g., Copilot-assisted draft runbooks, KB articles, ticket summarization, and log pattern identification)
+ Pilot small-scale AI/automation ideations with measurable success criteria (time saved, reduced rework, improved compliance)
+ Ensure AI usage adheres to organizational security, privacy, and data handling policies (no sensitive data leakage)
+ Leverage enterprise-approved AI tools to enhance productivity and innovation by streamlining workflows and automating repetitive tasks. Evaluate emerging trends to drive continuous improvement and strategic innovation.

* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications**

* 6+ years of hands-on administrative experience using SCCM
* 3+ years of hands-on administrative experience using Intune
* Operations, Health and Availability experience

+ Health monitoring and remediation: client health, enrollment success, policy/app deployment success, content distribution health
+ Service reliability ownership: stability, availability, and operational hygiene

* Patching and Vulnerability Operations experience

+ MECM patching operations: ADRs, deployment rings, maintenance windows, compliance reporting
+ Vulnerability remediation support: execute remediation plans and validate compliance within required timelines

* Automation and Scripting experience

+ PowerShell scripting for automation and remediation; familiarity with scheduled tasks and basic safe rollout practices
+ Ability to create repeatable runbooks and operational checklists

* ITSM and Operational Excellence

+ Experience working in war rooms and providing concise technical updates for rapid restoration
+ Working knowledge of Incident/Problem/Change management; ability to write clear change plans and validation steps
+ Ownership mindset for SLA adherence and MTTR reduction

* Proven Core Technical Skills (Primary)

+ Omnissa Workspace ONE UEM: 1+ years; administrative depth (profiles, Smart Groups, app distribution, compliance policies, device troubleshooting)
+ MECM/SCCM: application model, collections, deployments, boundaries, content distribution, client health, reporting
+ Microsoft Intune: enrollment methods, configuration/compliance policies, Win32 app deployment, troubleshooting, RBAC
+ Dual UEM operations: support coexistence, minimize policy conflicts, and ensure consistent end-user experience

* Proven AI Adoption and Continuous Improvement

+ Comfort using approved AI tools to accelerate documentation, analysis, and knowledge management
+ Ability to identify repetitive tasks suitable for automation or AI assistance and propose improvements

* Solid understanding of packaging and deployment of applications (MSI/EXE/MSIX/Win32) using SCCM/Intune using detection methods, dependencies, supersedence, and phased ring deployments

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Computer Science or equivalent experience
* ITIL Foundation, Microsoft endpoint-related certifications, Workspace ONE training/certification
* 2+ years of hands-on administrative experience with Omnissa Workspace ONE UEM (formerly AirWatch)

**Success Measures**

* Endpoint platform health and availability maintained with sustained reduction in unhealthy clients/devices
* Patch compliance and vulnerability remediation achieved within agreed windows; improved deployment success rates
* Reduced repeat incidents through better RCA documentation, known error articles, and proactive remediation

title: Technical Implementation Manager
description:
At Landis+Gyr, we're helping shape the future of energy—making it more intelligent, resilient, and sustainable.
  
  
As a global energy technology leader, we're accelerating the energy evolution through purposeful innovation and trusted partnerships. Trusted by more than 2,000 utilities worldwide, our intelligent solutions connect devices, data, and decisions across the grid, helping customers modernize infrastructure, optimize operations, and deliver energy that is more reliable, resilient, accessible, safe, and sustainable.
  
  
Behind every solution is a team of approximately 3,300 employees across more than 40 countries who are passionate about solving complex challenges, driving innovation, and making a meaningful impact for our utility customers and the communities they serve.
  
  
Join Team Green and help shape the future of intelligent energy.
  
  
**Technical Implementation Manager**
The Technical Implementation Manager (TIM) owns the technical delivery of Landis+Gyr's AMI products and solutions for new customer deployments and upgrades. The role covers both containerized deployments on Kubernetes (GKE and RKE), delivered using CI/CD pipelines and automation, and multi-tier deployments of the Head-End System (HES) across Windows and Linux servers. Across both, the TIM takes the Landis+Gyr solution from environment readiness through to production, covering the full stack from head-end software to field network endpoints.
  
  
Working closely with Program Managers, infrastructure teams, customer IT and operations teams, and Landis+Gyr engineering and product groups, the TIM is accountable for a successful go-live. This includes resolving technical issues that arise during deployment and the hypercare period, and transitioning the solution smoothly to the support organization. The role calls for deep hands-on DevOps expertise and a strong working knowledge of GCP, combined with the planning and customer-facing skills needed to deliver complex deployments on schedule.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end technical deployment of Landis+Gyr AMI solutions for new customers and upgrades, from environment readiness through go-live, planning activities with Program Managers and managing dependencies and risks.
* Validate that provisioned GCP and RKE environments meet deployment prerequisites, working with the infrastructure teams responsible for provisioning them.
* Deploy, configure and upgrade containerized applications on Kubernetes (GKE and RKE) using Docker and Helm charts.
* Install, configure and upgrade the Head-End System (HES) across its multi-tier architecture (network, metrology, web, application and adapter tiers) on Windows and Linux servers, including IIS and .NET-based components.
* Use and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins or similar) and scripting (PowerShell, Bash) to automate deployment, upgrade and rollback, and build reusable deployment templates across customers.
* Set up monitoring, logging and alerting so deployed applications are production-ready at go-live.
* Deliver integrations between the Landis+Gyr head-end and customer enterprise systems (e.g., MDM, CIS).
* Lead System Acceptance Testing (SAT) for new deployments and upgrades, driving defects to resolution.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues during deployment and hypercare through root cause analysis, engaging engineering, product, infrastructure and support teams as needed.
* Manage the formal handover to support teams, including operational documentation, runbooks and knowledge transfer.
* Follow formal change control processes and keep ServiceNow records complete for deployment-phase changes and issues.
* Act as the customer's technical point of contact, leading technical workshops and liaising across Landis+Gyr business units throughout the deployment.

**Key Competencies**

* Automation-first mindset, making every deployment repeatable, version-controlled and scripted
* Proven ownership of complex deployments end to end, from planning through go-live
* Strong planning and prioritization skills across parallel workstreams
* Methodical analytical and troubleshooting skills, with sound technical judgment
* Clear, confident communicator with customer technical teams, both written and verbal
* Self-starter who works independently, collaborates across teams and performs under time pressure
* Willingness to travel to customer sites (~50%)

**Technical Skills**
**Required:**

* Kubernetes: deploying and managing production workloads on GKE and RKE (Rancher Kubernetes Engine)
* Containers and packaging: Docker, Helm charts
* CI/CD: working with and maintaining pipelines in Jenkins or similar tools
* Google Cloud Platform (GCP): strong working knowledge of core services, as a user of GCP-hosted environments
* Infrastructure as code: working knowledge of Terraform
* Scripting and automation: PowerShell, Bash
* Version control: Git
* Operating systems: Linux/Unix and Microsoft Windows Server, for application deployment
* Databases: Oracle, MS SQL, PostgreSQL
* Networking: IP suite and wireless/RF/broadband communication technologies
* IIS and .NET Framework

**Preferred:**

* Monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK)
* Hardware Security Modules (HSM) and load balancers
* Two-way AMI technology, from head-end software to field endpoints

**Qualifications – Education And Experience**

* B.E./B.Tech in Electronics & Communication, Computer Science or IT
* 10+ years of industry experience, including at least 6 years in DevOps, cloud-based or technical deployment roles

* Experience delivering solutions that combine software and hardware

* Energy utility or AMI operations experience is a plus

We value and encourage diversity in our team. This position is open to all qualified candidates regardless of gender, race, age, disability, sexual orientation, or background. We're committed to shaping a better future for everyone. Join Team Green and be part of what's next in energy.

title: Manager - Fire and Security
description:
To manage and ensure the overall security, fire & life safety, emergency preparedness and risk management of the mall. The role will be responsible for protecting customers, tenants, employees, assets and infrastructure while ensuring compliance with statutory requirements, fire safety norms, mall SOPs and client standards.

**Job Descriptions:**

* Manage overall security operations of the mall, including entry/exit gates, parking, loading/unloading, BOH, service and common areas.
* Supervise security agencies, manpower deployment, shift rosters and daily operations.
* Ensure effective access control, frisking, baggage/vehicle checks and material movement.
* Monitor CCTV, access control and security control room operations and ensure system uptime.
* Identify and address security risks, theft, unauthorized access, vandalism and suspicious activities.
* Develop and implement security SOPs, post orders and emergency response procedures.
* Ensure readiness and effective functioning of all fire & life-safety systems, including fire alarm, hydrant, sprinkler, pumps, extinguishers, fire exits, emergency lighting and evacuation systems.
* Conduct regular fire, safety and security inspections and ensure timely closure of observations and system defects.
* Prepare and conduct mock drills for fire, evacuation, bomb threats, medical emergencies, civil disturbances and other emergencies.
* Lead emergency response and coordinate with police, fire department, civil defence and other statutory authorities.
* Ensure compliance with statutory requirements, Fire NOC conditions, licenses, inspections and audits.
* Manage tenant and contractor compliance with security, fire safety and work permit requirements.
* Monitor high-risk activities such as hot work, work-at-height and contractor movement.
* Lead and train Security Officers, Supervisors, Guards, Fire Officers, Firemen and Control Room personnel.
* Conduct regular briefings, toolbox talks, patrols and surprise checks to maintain discipline and operational readiness.
* Investigate security/fire incidents, accidents, thefts and property damage and prepare RCA and corrective action reports.
* Maintain incident records, statutory documents, inspection reports, registers and security/fire MIS.
* Manage VIP visits, mall events, launches and other special security arrangements.
* Implement effective traffic management plans and ensure smooth vehicle and pedestrian movement within the mall.
* Monitor security and fire-related KPIs and drive continuous improvement in safety, security and customer experience.
* Ensure timely reporting and escalation of critical incidents to senior management.

**Requirements:**

* Graduate / Diploma / Degree in Security, Fire & Safety or relevant discipline.
* 8 to 10 Years of relevant experience preferably with Mall / Retail / Hospitality / Commercial / Large Facility Management .
* Strong experience in managing security agencies and large security/fire safety teams.
* Hands-on knowledge of fire & life-safety systems, CCTV, access control and emergency response.
* Good understanding of Fire NOC, statutory compliance, safety audits and regulatory requirements.
* Experience in conducting mock drills, emergency preparedness and incident investigations.
* Strong experience in tenant, contractor and vendor management.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with Police, Fire Department, Civil Defence and other authorities.
* Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving and crisis-management skills.
* Experience in traffic management and crowd control in high-footfall environments.
* Should be comfortable working in shifts, weekends and during emergencies/events.
* Strong documentation, reporting and MIS skills.

title: Manager - IT Business Analysis
description:
Internal Job Posting
  
  
Last date to apply : 28th Oct
  
  
We are seeking a talented individual to join Marsh People & Investment at Marsh Tech. This role will be based in Noida/Gurgaon. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
Manager - IT Business Analysis - AI
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Systems Analyst is a role in our scaled agile framework POD and Squad model. As part of a POD team the Senior System Analyst will support one or more cross-functional squads comprised of a Squad Lead, Developers, a System Analyst, and Quality Assurance Engineers committed to ensuring the successful design and delivery of complex application solutions centered on the strategic roadmap for one or more key technology capabilities within MMC. The Senior System Analyst will be primarily responsible for directing the cross-functional elicitation and elaboration of requirements across squads in an Agile Team setting.
  
  
As part of your daily activities, you will collaborate with the Product Owner and teams to manage tactical aspects of iteration planning such as the squads’ backlog, backlog grooming, user story refinement, user story estimation, facilitating Sprint Reviews, and participating in Agile Ceremonies. As a trusted part of a team, you will coordinate activities with up to four System Analysts across squads to ensure just-in-time development of the story.
  
  
You will also assist the Product Owner in the development of personas, customer journey maps, story maps and release planning to foster insights and understanding of vision for the team.
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Be a highly motivated team player working within MMC Agile culture, within a specified agile framework of Scrum or KANBAN and maintain a willingness for continuously improving your agile mindset.
* Direct analysis on critical initiatives requiring significant strategic change across multiple platforms and products.
* Ensure that teams are consistently converting the business requirements to solutions, consisting of epics and features, considering technical constraints and existing technical architecture/functionality.
* Work with the Product Owner to communicate the product vision, roadmap, value, and MVP to the agile teams to enable empathy and a shared understanding thereby helping the team to formulate an appropriate solution.
* Collaborate with the Pod Leadership, Product Owner, and stakeholders to create Persona’s, Story Maps, and a Release Plan for the project.
* Work in partnership with the Product Owner and agile teams in the creation and maintenance of Product Backlog Items ensuring that Epics and User Stories are continuously prioritized and aligned to the Product Roadmap and MVP.
* Facilitate refinement sessions with the Agile Teams and Business to sufficiently detail out User Stories, to include dependencies.
* Facilitate the Sprint Review ceremony by working with the agile teams, Product Owner, Business and Customer to review, assess and adapt the latest product increment by incorporating customer insights and feedback into the Product Backlog.
* Actively work with Pod Leadership by running assessments processes for the POD and provide constructive feedback towards continuously improving the Systems Analyst function, standards and processes in Global Technology.
* Lead workshops and work collaboratively with data engineers, data architects, technical experts, and AI engineers to integrate AI solutions into a POD.
* Demonstrate an awareness of MMC and Mercer Technical, Security and Process Standards and work with the team to incorporate them in product delivery through the software development life cycle.

**What you need to have:**

* Highly motivated candidate who is an inquisitive rapid learner that is comfortable working as part of a remote team.
* Possess strong communication skills with the capability of working collaboratively within the organization, regardless of boundaries.
* An effective communicator for both technical and business-oriented audience.
* Demonstrated requirements gathering skills showcasing the capture of customer needs and business drivers using a variety of techniques into product backlog items such as Epics and User Stories.
* Proven quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in providing process improvement and integration opportunities with other process automation tools.
* Self-motivated and ability to learn through research and self-training.
* Ability to remove impediments for squads by providing timely responses and solutions as required.
* Ability to find resolutions regarding own work methods requiring minimal direction.
* Be willing to respond to emergent changes rather than focused on existing plans.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, and data analytics, while ensuring compliance with AI governance frameworks. Leverage these technologies to enhance user experiences and improve decision-making processes within applications.
* Minimum 12 months experience as D1/D2
* Should have at least “On-Track” or equivalent rating in last appraisal.
* Should not be under any Performance Counselling Plan or had any official disciplinary action within the last 3 months.

**What makes you stand out?**

* Ability to craft effective prompts that optimize AI responses, enhancing the functionality of AI-driven applications for problem-solving, analysis, and content generation.
* Capability to work within a POD/ cross-functional squads to develop and implement an AI strategy that aligns with business needs.
* Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends, technologies, and best practices to continuously improve AI capabilities within the organization.
* An Agile Mindset with an in-depth understanding of Agile Principles.
* Must have prior experience as an IT Systems Analyst or IT Business Analyst working as part of an agile team using an Agile Workflow tool such as JIRA or TFS.
* Agile Certification, such as CSM, PSM, CSPO, PSPO, PMI-ACP, Certified SAFe Practitioner, Azure AI Fundamentals is desirable.

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.

  .

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a short paid assignment involving a 20–30 second ad for a Wishluck product and three alternative hooks, including at least one AI-assisted hook.

We are looking for a creative professional who combines
**ad strategy, shooting, editing, AI tools, and performance marketing**
to build ads that drive sales—not just views.

title: Sr. Security Operations Analyst
description:
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a highly technical and proactive Sr. Security Operations Analyst to join our Information Security team. In this role you will engineer and mature our security operations infrastructure — designing automated playbooks, tuning advanced telemetry across SIEM, EDR, and cloud environments, and leading high-severity incident containment. As a senior member of the team, you will define triage standards and elevate the technical capability of the wider SOC.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Detection engineering: Architect and optimize real-time detection engineering playbooks across SIEM, EDR, and cloud security platforms to minimize false positives, accelerate triage, and scale threat-hunting capability.
* Investigation: Investigate suspicious activity, correlate findings across data sources, and document clear, timely case notes for each alert or incident.
* Incident command: Lead the response lifecycle for high-severity incidents as primary investigator or incident commander, ensuring seamless coordination and technical handoff across cross-functional teams.
* Containment: Execute containment actions under established playbooks, including endpoint isolation, disabling compromised accounts, and blocking malicious indicators.
* Threat hunting: Research indicators of compromise and apply threat intelligence to identify anomalous behavior.
* Rule tuning: Tune detection rules and use cases to reduce false positives and close visibility gaps, in coordination with engineering.
* Email threats: Investigate and remediate email-based threats such as phishing and business email compromise, from both user submissions and automated detection.
* Continuous improvement: Contribute to post-incident reviews and metrics reporting — MTTD, MTTR, alert volume, and false-positive rate — to support ongoing SOC maturity.
* Currency: Stay current on emerging threats, attacker TTPs, and industry frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

**Requirements**

* SIEM platforms
* Splunk
* Microsoft Sentinel
* QRadar
* EDR platforms
* CrowdStrike
* Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
* SentinelOne
* Windows operating systems
* Linux operating systems
* TCP/IP
* DNS
* Firewalls
* Network proxies
* Incident response
* Threat hunting
* Detection engineering
* Log analysis
* MITRE ATT&CK framework
* Phishing investigation
* Business email compromise
* Written communication
* Case documentation

**Preferred Skills**

* AWS
* Azure
* GCP
* Cloud security
* SOAR platforms
* Python
* PowerShell
* KQL
* SPL
* Security automation
* Playbook development

**Qualifications**

* 4–6 years of IT or security experience, including hands-on exposure to a SOC, security help desk, or systems administration environment
* 3+ years monitoring or investigating alerts using a SIEM (e.g., Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar) and an EDR platform (e.g., CrowdStrike, Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne)
* Working knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems, including common attack surfaces and log sources such as event logs, auth logs, and process telemetry
* Foundational understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, proxies, firewalls) and the protocols relevant to intrusion detection
* Strong attention to detail, sound judgment under time pressure, and clear written communication for case documentation and shift handoffs
* Ability to work effectively in a 24/7 SOC rotation, including scheduled shifts and periodic on-call coverage
* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field — or equivalent hands-on experience
* Foundational certifications such as CompTIA Security+ or CySA+ are expected; progress toward GIAC (GCIH, GFACT) or similar is a plus

title: Senior consultant- Waste Advisory

The role requires a combination of strong technical capability, project leadership, client engagement and commercial awareness. The candidate will work within a multidisciplinary team serving public- and private-sector clients across a range of markets, including government, real estate, infrastructure, industrial, commercial and event developments.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop circular economy, resource recovery, waste minimisation, diversion and zero-waste strategies aligned with project objectives and applicable policy requirements.

* Manage day-to-day project delivery, including scope, programme, budget, risks, resourcing, quality and coordination with multidisciplinary and geographically dispersed teams.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Travel Consulting and Travel Management to design suitable itineraries and oversee end-to-end trip planning.
* Candidates should possess practical experience in Travel Arrangements and Reservations to handle bookings, scheduling, and vendor coordination effectively.
* Candidates should possess excellent Customer Service skills to address inquiries, provide guidance, and ensure a positive traveler experience throughout the journey.
* Candidates should possess good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage diverse travelers and explain complex travel details clearly.
* Candidates should possess strong organizational and time-management abilities, with attention to detail and accuracy in documentation and scheduling.
* Candidates should possess comfort with basic computer applications and travel-related tools; familiarity with CRM or booking platforms is an advantage.
* Previous experience in travel, tourism, hospitality, or trip operations is preferred; knowledge of Indian destinations and Himalayan regions is a plus.
* A relevant diploma or degree in Travel & Tourism, Hospitality, Business, or a related field is beneficial, though practical experience and passion for travel are highly valued.

title: Systems Engineering  Advisor - Endpoint Management-Patch/Deployment/SCCM Analyst
description:
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Systems Engineering Advisor - Endpoint Management-Patch/Deployment/SCCM Analyst to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN-UP), India (IN).
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced SCCM/Intune Lead Engineer to join NTT DATA's India EPM Delivery Centre. This lead-level role combines deep technical expertise with delivery ownership — driving complex SCCM/Intune engagements, leading technical teams, architecting enterprise endpoint solutions, and serving as a key client-facing technical authority for EPM workstreams from India. The Lead Engineer plays a critical role in NTT DATA's EPM service delivery quality, client satisfaction, and practice capability growth, supporting global accounts across the US, Europe, and APAC.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Technical Leadership & Architecture
  
  

* Lead end-to-end design and implementation of enterprise SCCM/ConfigMgr and Microsoft Intune environments for global client accounts.
* Architect co-management strategies, Autopilot provisioning frameworks, and Modern Management transition roadmaps.
* Own the technical direction for SCCM-to-Intune migration engagements including workload transition planning, timeline development, and risk mitigation.
* Define EPM platform standards, governance frameworks, and configuration baselines across multiple global accounts managed from India.
* Evaluate emerging Microsoft Endpoint Manager capabilities and provide technical roadmap recommendations to delivery managers and clients.

Enterprise Patch Management
  
  

* Own enterprise-level patch management programs — governing policy, SLAs, exception management, and compliance reporting across 10,000+ endpoint fleets.
* Design and manage Intune Expedite policies, WUfB rings, and SCCM ADR-based patching for complex multi-site global environments.
* Lead vulnerability remediation programs integrating Qualys/Tenable findings with SCCM/Intune patch deployment cycles.
* Develop patching governance documentation, escalation playbooks, and compliance dashboards for client and internal stakeholders.
* Lead emergency and zero-day patching response including containment, deployment, and post-incident review from India delivery centre.

Advanced OS Deployment & Provisioning
  
  

* Lead enterprise Windows 11 migration programs including readiness assessment, task sequence design, pilot execution, and phased rollout.
* Design and deliver Windows Autopilot + Intune Zero Touch Provisioning frameworks for large-scale global device refresh programs.
* Own OSD platform operations — WinPE environments, MDT integration, driver library management, and image currency.
* Architect golden image build pipelines, compliance validation, and automated post-deployment configuration.
* Define device lifecycle management policies from procurement through decommission for managed global client environments.

Automation & Integration
  
  

* Architect PowerShell-based automation frameworks for SCCM and Intune operational efficiency and compliance reporting.
* Lead development of Microsoft Graph API integrations for Intune bulk operations, automated policy enforcement, and reporting.
* Design SCCM SQL/Power BI reporting solutions for delivery management and client-level visibility into endpoint health and patch posture.
* Oversee integration between EPM platforms and security tooling (Qualys, Defender for Endpoint) for holistic endpoint health management.

Client Engagement & Delivery Governance
  
  

* Serve as primary technical point of contact for assigned EPM accounts — leading governance calls, delivery reviews, and escalation resolution from India.
* Drive SLA attainment, delivery quality, and continuous improvement across managed global endpoint accounts.
* Contribute to SOW development, effort estimation, and technical proposal documentation for new and expanding EPM engagements.
* Mentor and develop Grade 7–9 engineers through technical coaching, design reviews, and structured capability building.
* Collaborate with NTT DATA India practice leadership and onshore counterparts on EPM service development and client strategies.

**Required Skills**

* Microsoft SCCM/ConfigMgr — site architecture, hierarchy design, OSD, patch management, reporting (expert)
* Microsoft Intune — full MDM/MAM lifecycle, co-management, Autopilot, WUfB, Conditional Access (expert)
* Windows 10/11 enterprise deployment — task sequences, MDT, WinPE, driver management, ZTP Autopilot
* Azure AD / Entra ID — identity-driven EPM, Conditional Access, MFA, device trust, RBAC
* PowerShell advanced automation — SCCM SDK, Graph API, reporting pipelines, operational tooling
* SQL Server + Power BI — SCCM database reporting, compliance dashboards, management-level visualizations
* Vulnerability management — Qualys/Tenable integration with patch management lifecycle
* Client-facing delivery governance from India — SLA management, delivery reviews, escalation ownership

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.

title: Technical Lead
description:
Vacancy Introduction
  
  
Haskoning is an independent consulting engineering company that is dedicated to creating a positive impact on people and planet. Backed by the expertise of over 6,000 colleagues working from offices in more than 20 countries, and with more than 140 years of experience under our belt, we are helping clients with challenges ranging from climate change and digital transformation to changing customer demands and the energy transition. * Strong expertise in water supply, sewerage, stormwater drainage, hydraulics, and hydrology.
* Proficiency in software such as WaterGEMS, SewerGEMS, MIKE, SWMM, EPANET, HEC-RAS, GIS, Civil 3D, SWAT, and HEC-HMS.

* Strong technical report writing and large data analysis skills.

Noida

Market competitive salary

title: Educational counsellor
description:
**Company Description**
JMV Educare Private Limited is an education-focused organization dedicated to guiding learners toward informed academic and career decisions. The company supports students and families through structured counseling, program awareness, and personalized guidance. JMV Educare collaborates with schools, colleges, and training providers to offer relevant educational pathways and career options. The team values ethical practices, clear communication, and student-centric services to ensure positive outcomes for learners.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Educational Counsellor role based in Noida. The Educational Counsellor will meet and advise students and families on academic options, courses, and career pathways, helping them make informed decisions aligned with their interests and goals. Daily responsibilities include conducting one-on-one and group counseling sessions, assessing student profiles, explaining programs and admissions processes, and maintaining accurate records of counseling interactions. The role involves coordinating with internal teams and educational institutions, organizing workshops or information sessions, and following up with students to support enrollment and progression. The Educational Counsellor is expected to maintain professional, inclusive communication and uphold the organization’s student-first approach.

**Qualifications**

* Ability to provide Educational Consulting and guidance on academic programs, institutions, and learning pathways.
* Skills in Student Counseling, including one-on-one sessions, group guidance, and addressing academic or adjustment concerns.
* Strong Communication skills, with the ability to explain complex information clearly and build trust with students and families.
* Experience or training in Career Counseling, helping students understand career options, job trends, and skill requirements.
* Solid understanding of the Education sector, admission processes, and curriculum structures.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Education, Psychology, Counseling, or a related field.
* Empathy, active listening, and a non-judgmental, inclusive approach to diverse student backgrounds.
* Organizational and record-keeping skills, with proficiency in basic computer applications and online communication tools.
* Previous experience in an educational institution, counseling center, or training organization is preferred.

title: Senior Telecaller
description:
**Company Description**
Altis Estate Pvt. Ltd. is a growing real estate company focused on providing residential and commercial property solutions to a wide range of clients. The organization emphasizes transparent transactions, customer satisfaction, and long-term client relationships. Team members work in a dynamic, target-driven environment with opportunities to learn about property markets and sales strategies. The company values professionalism, integrity, and strong communication, and offers growth opportunities for individuals who demonstrate initiative and performance.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Senior Telecaller role based in Noida. The Senior Telecaller will handle outbound and inbound calls to prospective and existing clients, introduce real estate offerings, and generate qualified leads for the sales team. Responsibilities include explaining property details, answering queries, maintaining call logs and CRM records, and following up with leads to schedule site visits and meetings. title: USA Onboarding Professional (Background Verification Specialist)
description:
**Title: USA Onboarding Professional (USA Background Verification Specialist)**

**Location: Noida (Onsite)**

**About the Role**

We are seeking a detail-driven and proactive
**USA Onboarding Professional**
with robust experience managing end-to-end background verification (BGV) processes for US-based hires. In this role, you will act as the crucial link between our organization, incoming candidates, and leading BGV vendor partners. Your expertise will ensure that all onboarding and compliance checks are executed seamlessly, turnaround times (TAT) are minimized, and candidates are cleared efficiently for start dates.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **End-to-End BGV Management:**
  Coordinate and oversee comprehensive background screening for US candidates, covering criminal records, employment history, education verification, drug testing, and reference checks.
* **Vendor Collaboration & Relationship Management:**
  Serve as the primary point of contact for multiple BGV vendor partners (including
  **HireRight, USAFact, First Advantage**
  , and others), driving accountability and resolving bottlenecks to accelerate report clearances.
* **TAT & Milestone Tracking:**
  Monitor daily status dashboards across various vendor portals, actively following up on pending or delayed checks to ensure compliance with aggressive client and internal onboarding timelines.
* **Dispute & Exception Handling:**
  Review complex or flagged BGV reports, coordinate with legal/compliance teams, and manage pre-adverse/adverse action workflows in strict alignment with federal, state, and local regulations (e.g., FCRA).
* **Candidate Experience & Support:**
  Guide incoming candidates through the digital document submission process, answer inquiries regarding required disclosures, and assist them in clearing verification roadblocks.
* **Compliance & Documentation:**
  Maintain accurate, audit-ready compliance records and securely archive completed verification files within the ATS/HRIS platform.
* **Process Optimization:**
  Identify recurring vendor delays or process inefficiencies and recommend workflow improvements to streamline the onboarding lifecycle.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* **Experience:**
  3 to 6 years of dedicated experience in US HR operations, compliance, recruitment operations, or candidate onboarding, with a strong focus on background screening.
* **Vendor Expertise:**
  Hands-on, working familiarity with major US BGV platforms such as
  **HireRight, First Advantage, USAFact, Sterling, or similar industry providers**
  .
* **Regulatory Knowledge:**
  Sound understanding of US compliance standards related to hiring and screening, including
  **FCRA (Fair Credit Reporting Act)**
  guidelines, EEOC regulations, and state-specific ban-the-box laws.
* **Communication Skills:**
  Excellent written and verbal communication skills to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams, external vendors, and high-volume candidate pipelines.
* **Technical Proficiency:**
  Proficient in using Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), HRIS platforms, and advanced MS Excel/Google Sheets for tracking metrics and TAT reports.
* **Attention to Detail:**
  Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple high-priority onboarding schedules simultaneously under tight deadlines.

With current management coming in, the construction operations were digitized through simple spreadsheets and this move to digital spurred us into the IT/ITES industry leading to dealerships for large IT companies like IBM, Wipro, CISCO, EMC and others as System Integrators and customer support. Our teams support Veoci in application development and many backend services. Core implementation and configuration support is provided directly by our Solution and Implementation Engineers to clients across the US. Iprime is the authorized partner for Veoci in Asia,Middleast and Africa and is a key backoffice delivery organisation to Veoci Inc.*

*More information can be found at: www.iprimeserv.com.*

*At Iprime, you’ll be part of a dynamic and fast-growing team dedicated to solving real-world challenges with innovative technology. Our collaborative and inclusive culture encourages creativity, professional growth, and customer success. This is your opportunity to make an impact by helping organizations worldwide implement smarter, more effective systems for mission-critical operations.*

title: Associate Director - Product
description:
Technical Product Manager
  
  
**Location:**
Noida / Remote / Hybrid
  
  
**Department:**
Product & Technology
  
  
**Reports To:**
Chief Executive Officer (Product Strategist)
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Technical Product Manager who can own a product end to end — from the first spark of an idea through design, development, and launch. This is a hands-on role for someone who thinks like a designer, understands code and system architecture, and can turn ambiguous problems into shipped products.
  
  
This role is unique in two ways. First, product direction comes from our CEO acting as Product Strategist: you will operate with a strong Business Analyst mindset, eliciting requirements from strategic conversations and turning high-level vision into precise, buildable specifications. You will do the same with very non-technical stakeholders — including the CFO and other executives — converting business and financial needs into clear product requirements. Second, we run a Rapid Development Framework with sprints executed in 2-day cycles, so speed of translation from idea to working prototype to shipped increment is the core skill of this job.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Requirements from the Product Strategist — Work directly with the CEO/Product Strategist to capture product vision and strategy; run structured elicitation sessions, ask the questions that surface hidden requirements, and translate strategic intent into PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Business analysis with non-technical stakeholders — Elicit and document requirements from non-technical executives such as the CFO — interviewing, workshopping, and process-mapping to convert business, financial, and operational needs into unambiguous specifications developers can build from.
* Rapid prototyping & sign-off — Build rapid prototypes (wireframes, clickable mockups, working demos in tools like Figma or lightweight code) within hours or days, walk stakeholders through them, incorporate feedback in fast iteration loops, and drive to formal sign-off before development begins.
* 2-day sprint cycles — Operate our Rapid Development Framework: plan, scope, and close sprints on 2-day cycles; break features into increments buildable within a cycle; run tight stand-ups; and keep a continuously groomed, developer-ready backlog.
* Developer collaboration — Collaborate daily with engineers to scope feasibility, make speed/quality/scope trade-offs in real time, unblock development, and coordinate QA and launch readiness in a fast-paced environment.
* Roadmap & metrics — Own the roadmap for your product area, prioritizing by customer impact, business value, and technical effort; define and track post-launch metrics and use data to drive the next iterations.
* Communication — Communicate progress, decisions, and trade-offs clearly to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, adapting your style for engineers, designers, executives, and customers.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* Experience owning products end to end — concept through design, development, and post-launch iteration — not just managing a backlog.
* Strong Business Analyst skillset: proven ability to elicit requirements from senior, strategy-level stakeholders (CEO/founder level) and from non-technical executives (CFO, operations leaders), and to document them as clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Demonstrated rapid prototyping ability — wireframing, prototyping, and using tools such as Figma — with a track record of getting stakeholder sign-off quickly and using prototypes to de-risk development.
* Experience in accelerated or rapid development environments (short sprint cycles, RAD, or continuous delivery); comfort planning and shipping in 2-day sprint cycles.
* Solid technical foundation: comfortable reading code, understanding APIs and system architecture, and having informed technical conversations with engineers without necessarily writing production code.
* Strong product thinking — able to break vague problems into structured, testable hypotheses and make sound trade-off decisions under time pressure.
* Comfort using data to decide: defining metrics, analyzing funnels, and running experiments such as A/B tests.
* Thrives in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment with shifting priorities and direct executive visibility.
* Typically 7 to 12 years in product management and business analysis, with prior experience in software engineering, design, or a technical role a strong plus.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience with SaaS or B2B products; prior startup or early-stage experience where you wore multiple hats.
* Familiarity with SQL or basic scripting for pulling and analyzing your own data.
* Exposure to design systems and component libraries.
* Experience working directly with founders or C-suite as the primary source of product direction.

title: Senior Salesforce Administrator
description:
**A Little About Us**
Enboarder is the world’s first agentic AI employee journey platform, unifying onboarding, enablement, mobility, and offboarding into a single experience layer.
  
  
With AI Assistants and AI Agents working together, Enboarder empowers HR leaders to deliver structured, personalized employee experiences at scale while freeing HR from administrative work. Enterprises like Deloitte, ING, T-Mobile, andCisco use Enboarder accelerate time-to-productivity, reduce attrition, and unlock HR capacity
  
  
The result: engaged managers, supported employees, and measurable business impact.
  
  
**Role Summary**
Enboarder is seeking a motivated and results-driven Senior Salesforce Administrator to join our Revenue Operations team, reporting to the Sr. Director of Revenue Operations. This pivotal role will focus on optimizing and managing our Salesforce instance and integration architecture to deliver reliable systems, clean data, and scalable processes that support pipeline generation, customer growth, and operational efficiency. If you are an experienced Salesforce professional who thrives on improving business processes and collaborating with cross-functional teams, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Platform Ownership & Best Practices: Serve as the go-to technical resource and subject-matter expert on Salesforce best practices, staying ahead of new platform capabilities and applying them to continuously improve our systems and processes.
* Configuration and Customization: Customize Salesforce to meet business requirements, including the creation of custom objects, fields, validation rules, workflows, page layouts, and record types.
* CPQ Administration: Own configuration and maintenance of Salesforce CPQ — including price books, product bundles, discount schedules, quote templates, and approval workflows — to support accurate, scalable quote-to-cash processes.
* Automation & Process Optimization: Design, build, troubleshoot, and optimize Salesforce Flows and other automation to streamline and scale business processes as requirements evolve.
* Solution Delivery: Translate business requirements into scalable Salesforce solutions — owning scoping, design, and partnering with stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance throughout project execution.
* GTM Systems Integration: Maintain and support integrations between Salesforce and the broader GTM technology stack (e.g. HubSpot, Planhat, Gong, ZoomInfo, etc.), ensuring reliable data sync and system performance across the revenue organization.
* User Enablement & Support: Provide enablement and day-to-day support to end users — including triaging and resolving CPQ / Opp-related issues, and other ad hoc requests from sales reps — to ensure teams are proficient in Salesforce and can fully leverage its capabilities.
* Data Management & Governance: Ensure data integrity through data cleansing, de-duplication, and regular data maintenance activities, including regular account and contact association audits to maintain consistent, reliable data across Salesforce and connected systems.
* Reports and Dashboards: Create and manage reports, dashboards, and analytics that provide visibility into funnel performance, ARR, and other key GTM metrics across sales, marketing, and customer success.
* User Management & Security: Create and manage user profiles, roles, and permissions to ensure appropriate access levels and data security.
* Documentation: Maintain detailed documentation of Salesforce configurations, automation, and business processes to support knowledge continuity.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experienced Salesforce Administrator (likely 5+ years experience) with demonstrated ability to own and deliver complex projects independently
* Salesforce Administrator certification and Salesforce Certified CPQ Specialist certification required; Advanced Administrator certification strongly preferred
* Strong experience designing, building, troubleshooting, and optimizing Salesforce Flows
* Proven experience with administrating and configuring Salesforce CPQ
* Previous experience in the Software industry with solid understanding of ARR/Subscription business model and sales processes
* Experience in integrating Salesforce with sales, marketing and customer success platforms (e.g. Slack, HubSpot, Gong, Planhat)
* Experience managing Salesforce sandboxes and release processes, including Change Sets, sandbox refreshes, and org migrations
* Experience with data management and integration concepts and data security best practices
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to effectively convey technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

**Nice To Have**

* Platform App Builder and/or Platform Developer I Certifications
* Experience developing for the Salesforce Platform (Apex Controllers, Triggers, Batch APEX, Visualforce, SOQL, SOSL, Lightning Web Components, and other Salesforce programmatic solutions)

*The Enboarder team is made up of people who excel in a wide variety of disciplines. Each member of our team brings their unique perspective and passions to everything we do. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t feel that you meet every single requirement. We’re eager to meet people that believe in our mission and can contribute to our team in a variety of ways—not just candidates who check all the boxes. We want our employees to feel comfortable expressing their true selves and to come, stay, and do their best work with us. We hope you’re feeling excited about the opportunity to join our team!*

All information collected during our application and interview process will be stored in accordance with the Privacy Act 1988 and Australian Privacy Principles.*

Job Summary

We are looking for a technically proficient
**Technical Support Specialist**
with hands-on experience in the CPaaS or telecommunications industry. The candidate will be responsible for troubleshooting communication platform issues, supporting API integrations, managing client onboarding, monitoring messaging services, and ensuring timely resolution of technical issues.

  .

* Experience troubleshooting API requests, integration errors, and message delivery issues.
* Familiarity with ticketing systems, CRM platforms, incident management, and SLA-based support.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Prior hands-on experience with a CPaaS provider, SMS gateway, or telecommunications service provider.
* Experience supporting enterprise clients and resolving complex messaging-related technical issues.

At Rightsline, we combine deep industry expertise with cutting-edge technology to solve complex challenges at scale. Our teams work at the intersection of technology, media, and innovation—building solutions that power the business of content worldwide.

  
  

Joining Rightsline means becoming part of a collaborative, forward-thinking environment where your ideas, expertise, and contributions directly shape the future of rights and royalties management. **What You Bring:**

* Strong communication skills and ability to break down complex problems into manageable parts

* Compliance with security and remote working policies
  

  
  

**Compensation & Growth:**

  

Competitive compensation aligned to market standards with strong career growth opportunities.

  
  

**Life at Rightsline India:**

  

At our India operations, we foster a culture of inclusiveness, accountability, and innovation. We believe in empowering our teams to take ownership, drive impact, and contribute meaningfully to global success.
  
  
  
 We offer a structured yet flexible work environment that balances performance with employee well-being. Our benefits framework for India includes:

* Comprehensive Group Medical Insurance covering employees and their eligible dependents
  
* Group Personal Accident Insurance for enhanced financial security
  
* In-office meal benefits, including sponsored breakfast, lunch, and evening snacks
  
* Hybrid work model with clearly defined collaboration days

* Career growth and advancement opportunities within a rapidly scaling global SaaS organization
  
* Continuous learning, upskilling, and leadership development support
  
* Quarterly employee engagement initiatives, along with celebrations and recognition programs
  

  
  
  

You will work alongside a globally connected team with strong leadership support and collaborative cross-functional exposure. We encourage proactive thinking, ownership, and initiative—ideas are welcomed, and execution is supported. As a people-first organization, we are committed to building a high-performance culture where growth, accountability, and innovation go hand in hand.

  
  

**Hiring Process:**

* Technical / Functional Interview

title: Senior Atlassian Admin
description:
**Job Description - Senior Atlassian Admin**

  
  

**About Rightsline:**

  
  

At Rightsline, we are redefining how the global media and entertainment industry manages and monetizes intellectual property. Since 2012, Rightsline has been trusted by some of the world’s most influential studios, broadcasters, and content owners to simplify the complex world of rights and royalties through powerful, intelligent technology.

  
  

Our cloud-based, fully integrated platform provides a single source of truth for managing rights, royalties, contracts, and financial workflows across markets, territories, and distribution channels. By bringing together data, automation, and collaboration in one configurable ecosystem, we enable organizations to unlock the full value of their content portfolios while operating with greater transparency, efficiency, and control.

  
  

At Rightsline, we combine deep industry expertise with cutting-edge technology to solve complex challenges at scale. Our teams work at the intersection of technology, media, and innovation—building solutions that power the business of content worldwide.

  
  

Joining Rightsline means becoming part of a collaborative, forward-thinking environment where your ideas, expertise, and contributions directly shape the future of rights and royalties management. If you are passionate about building impactful technology and working alongside talented global teams, Rightsline offers the platform to grow, innovate, and make a meaningful difference.

  
  

**What You Will Own:**

  

**Instance Configuration & Governance**

  

  
* Own all shared configuration in our company-managed Jira Cloud instance: custom fields, screens and screen schemes, field configurations, workflows and workflow schemes, work types and hierarchy levels, priorities, resolutions, and permission and notification schemes.
  
* Apply and enforce the discipline company-managed Jira requires — establish whether an object is shared before changing it, and when it is, copy it, scope the copy to the project, and change the copy. Most instance damage comes from skipping this step.
  
* Own and maintain all the Atlassian sister products like Confluence, Jira Service Desk, and Jira Product Discovery
  
* Maintain naming conventions that make configuration ownership obvious at a glance, and run a recurring audit that catches projects drifting back onto shared objects.
  
* Keep the custom-field estate from growing unchecked: reuse before creating, scope through field contexts rather than editing shared ones, and retire fields no longer in use.
  
* Own project creation and decommissioning, and grant permissions to project roles rather than named individuals so access survives staffing changes.
  

  
  

**Workflow, Automation & App Administration**

  

  
* Translate how teams actually work into workflow, status, and board configuration — and propose the lighter alternative when a request is better solved by a convention than by new configuration.
  
* Publish workflow changes safely, including migrating in-flight work when statuses change, and keep board column mappings in step so nothing lands in an unmapped state.
  
* Build and maintain Jira Automation rules, scoped correctly so one team's rule does not surface in another team's menus.
  
* Administer our Marketplace apps — including their own scoping settings, and evaluate new apps before they become permanent.
  

  
  

**Confluence & Process Documentation**

  

  
* Own Confluence spaces, permissions, templates, and page hierarchy.
  
* Partner with engineering leads to get our delivery process written down and kept current: status definitions with owners and exit criteria, work-type guidance, Definition of Ready and Definition of Done, and branch-naming requirements. Company-managed Jira cannot hold per-project helper text, so Confluence is where this lives.
  
* Write short, durable runbooks for recurring requests, and train team leads to self-serve the routine changes.
  

  
  

**Reporting, Data & Integrations**

  

  
* Protect the conventions our delivery metrics depend on — the estimation field, status names, issue-key format, and what counts as a defect. Breaking one of these produces wrong numbers rather than an error message, so you are the last line of defence.
  
* Own the data contract behind our delivery-analytics platform (Plandek): which fields and statuses it reads, and what a rename would cost.
  
* Write JQL that answers non-trivial questions, build filters and dashboards, and run bulk changes safely.
  
* Use the Jira Cloud REST API for work with no UI path — bulk version creation, field inventories, and pulling issue changelogs for time-in-status and flow metrics. Changelog data cannot be reached through CSV export, so this is a working requirement rather than a bonus.
  
* Maintain the Jira–Git integration that drives status transitions, along with the Zendesk, Salesforce, and Sentry connectors.
  

  
  

**Access, Compliance & Support**

  

  
* Produce access-review and change-management evidence for SOC 2: who holds admin rights, who holds elevated issue permissions, and what changed when.
  
* Own Atlassian onboarding and offboarding, licence allocation, and seat cost management.
  
* Be the first and last stop for “Jira is broken” — diagnosing with the tooling (permission helper, automation audit logs) rather than reasoning from first principles, since most reports resolve to a handful of known causes.
  
* Collaborating with cross-functional teams
  
* Ensure compliance with ISO 27001, SOC 1, SOC 2 frameworks
  

  
  

**What You Bring:**

  

  
* 5+ years administering Atlassian Cloud, including hands-on ownership of a company-managed (not only team-managed) Jira instance where multiple projects share configuration. This is our most important requirement: team-managed-only experience does not transfer, because the whole difficulty of this role is shared configuration.
  
* Atlassian Certified Professional (Jira Administration or Jira Service Management).
  
* ScriptRunner (Groovy), or comparable depth administering Marketplace apps.
  
* Jira Service Management, Atlassian Guard / Access, or Atlassian Analytics.
  
* Experience with a delivery-metrics platform (Plandek, LinearB, Jellyfish, Sleuth) and the Jira data hygiene it requires.
  
* Having led a team-managed to company-managed migration, or a Server / Data Center to Cloud migration.
  
* Familiarity with SOC 2 or comparable audit evidence collection.
  
* Exposure to AI-assisted development tooling and how its activity should be represented in Jira.
  
* Demonstrated ownership of workflows, screen and field configuration schemes, issue type schemes, and permission schemes — you have built them, published them, and migrated existing issues through a status change.
  
* Jira Automation at a competent level: multi-step rules, smart values, branching, and correct rule scoping.
  
* Confluence administration: spaces, permissions, and templates.
  
* Strong JQL, plus filters, dashboards, and safe bulk operations.
  
* Scripting against the Jira REST API in Python, JavaScript, or equivalent, including token authentication, pagination, and changelog extraction.
  
* Judgment about blast radius — before changing anything you check what else depends on it, and you can be trusted with an instance twenty teams rely on.
  
* Willingness to push back: declining the request that would add a field nobody fills in or a status nobody exits, and proposing the lighter alternative.
  
* Clear written communication, a habit of documenting as you go, and experience working effectively with colleagues across time zones.
  

  
  

**Work Environment & Expectations:**

  

  
* Noida/NCR based
  
* Demonstrates flexibility to work in required shifts. Regular overlap with US-based engineering leadership, targeting 4 hours daily.
  
* Compliance with security and remote working policies
  

  
  

**Compensation & Growth:**

  

Competitive compensation aligned to market standards with strong career growth opportunities.

  
  

**Life at Rightsline India:**

  

At our India operations, we foster a culture of inclusiveness, accountability, and innovation. We believe in empowering our teams to take ownership, drive impact, and contribute meaningfully to global success.
  
  
  
 We offer a structured yet flexible work environment that balances performance with employee well-being. Our benefits framework for India includes:

* Quarterly employee engagement initiatives, along with celebrations and recognition programs
  

  
  

You will work alongside a globally connected team with strong leadership support and collaborative cross-functional exposure. We encourage proactive thinking, ownership, and initiative—ideas are welcomed, and execution is supported. As a people-first organization, we are committed to building a high-performance culture where growth, accountability, and innovation go hand in hand.

title: Digital Systems Lead – Construction Site Apps
description:
About us

KV Developers is part of ReaRCo, a restructuring and turnaround group that works on practical solutions to real-world problems. We are building a technology-driven construction company and are developing a range of in-house digital tools for our projects, starting at our residential project in Greater Noida West.

About the role

Our site already runs on in-house mobile apps for snagging and de-snagging of flats, daily monitoring of works, labour and contractors, and reports for management, built on Google Workspace and AppSheet with scripted automation. More tools will follow.

We are looking for one person to own the day-to-day running of these apps: making changes, keeping the data clean, testing before release, training site staff and contractors, and making sure the apps are actually used on site. You will work directly with the founder and the project leadership. Most technical design and coding is prepared with AI tools; your job is to turn decisions into working, well-tested tools quickly and get them adopted on site.

What you will do

- Configure and release changes to the apps (AppSheet) and their data (Google Sheets); keep a change log.

- Own master data: users and logins, roles, contractors, locations, work items and assignments.

- Test every change on a test copy before release, and run field tests with site teams.

- Train engineers, foremen, contractors and vendors in Hindi and English, and follow up until the apps are used daily.

- Track adoption and data quality, and send a short written summary each evening.

- Collect feedback from site and management into one list, and prepare specifications with AI tools for decisions.

- Act as second administrator for Google Workspace and related accounts; keep access, backups and documentation in order.

- Support a planned move of the data to a SQL database with a senior technical reviewer.

What we are looking for

- 4 to 8 years in residential or commercial construction as a civil, QA/QC or planning engineer, or a no-code developer with real site exposure.

- Confident with Google Sheets and at least one no-code or low-code tool (AppSheet preferred); able to read simple scripts.

- Comfortable working with AI tools (for example ChatGPT or Claude) to draft, check and document work.

- Methodical about testing, data and documentation.

- Fluent in Hindi and English; able to train site staff and hold contractors to a routine.

- Discreet with confidential data and systems.

Good to have: Apps Script or JavaScript, SQL, Looker Studio, MS Project or Primavera, experience rolling out a site app or ERP module.

Location and hours: at our site in Greater Noida West, Monday to Saturday; hybrid once the rollout settles.

Reports to: the founder, working closely with the project head on site and the planning head.

Compensation: competitive, in line with experience.

To apply: please include one example of a tool, app, sheet or process you built or rolled out, and what changed as a result.

**Company:**

Noida (On-Site)

Founder / Director

18+ Years
