title: CRO Specialist
description:
**About the role**

Axeno’s conversion rate optimization (CRO) and experimentation practice helps enterprise clients grow website conversion. We turn analytics evidence into prioritised experiments and personalized experiences, and prove the business impact.

As Scrum Master & CRO Specialist you are the analytical and delivery lead of a CRO squad. You own journey analysis, drop-off diagnosis, hypotheses, experiment design and KPI interpretation, and you run the sprint cadence that keeps every cycle on time, evidence-backed and decision-ready. You will also strengthen the practice by evolving the playbooks, templates and ways of working we reuse across clients.

**What you will do**

**CRO and insights**

•   
**Journey and funnel analysis.**
Analyse the end-to-end website journey in Adobe Analytics. Build funnels, fallout and cohort views by source, device and new vs returning traffic.

•   
**Drop-off diagnosis.**
Combine quantitative funnels with session replay, heatmaps, zoning and journey analysis from Microsoft Clarity and Contentsquare to explain friction.

•   
**Hypotheses.**
Produce focused insight briefs with ranked hypotheses, each with evidence, affected audience and a primary KPI.

•   
**Experiment design.**
Specify tests (A/B, experience targeting, personalization rules) with primary KPI, eligible audience, minimum detectable effect, allocation, control and decision window. Report absolute and relative effect with uncertainty and guardrails, and call “continue learning” when the evidence says so.

•   
**Measurement integrity.**
Define and maintain a measurement contract: journey events, experiment IDs, and reconciliation across SDK, analytics and server/CRM counts. Link website conversions to downstream lead quality.

•   
**Reporting.**
Maintain KPI dashboards covering conversion, lead quality and guardrails (Core Web Vitals, form reliability, personalization delivery, data integrity).

•   
**Activation partnership.**
Work with personalization and engineering specialists on Adobe Target and Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization campaigns: targeting logic, preview and tracking QA, rollout and rollback.

**Scrum and delivery**

•   
Run a fortnightly delivery cycle: evidence mining, test agreement, build and verify, release and review. Facilitate planning, daily check-ins, backlog refinement, reviews and retrospectives.

•   
Own the prioritised backlog and a written decision log (launch, continue, revise, stop, escalate). Prioritise by opportunity, effort and traffic using a framework such as ICE or PIE.

•   
Track dependencies on client platform, data and BAU teams (access, consent, SDK, approved content). Raise blockers and risks early, and keep acceptance evidence for every deliverable.

•   
Be the day-to-day contact for client marketing and digital stakeholders. Present readouts in plain business language, without overclaiming uplift.

**Practice contribution**

•   
Maintain and improve reusable assets: hypothesis and experiment brief templates, QA checklists, KPI frameworks, dashboards and a CRO operating playbook.

•   
Support pre-sales and proposals with CRO approach, scoping and case studies. Coach junior analysts and personalization specialists across the team.

**﻿
Must-have requirements**

**Non-negotiable**

*Hands-on CRO delivery for comparable customers (large consumer or lead-generation websites, ideally automotive, BFSI or other high-consideration journeys), with proven, quantified impact you can walk us through.*

•   
6–7 years in web analytics, CRO or digital optimization, with at least 3 years running an experimentation programme end to end.

•   
Case studies we can verify: the problem, hypothesis, test design, result (with confidence or uncertainty) and business impact, e.g. lift in lead or conversion rate without loss in lead quality.

•   
Strong Adobe Analytics skills: Analysis Workspace, segments, calculated metrics, fallout and flow, eVars/props/events.

•   
Hands-on experience with Adobe Target (activities, audiences, A/B and experience targeting, QA; A4T is a plus).

•   
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Clarity and Contentsquare for session replay, heatmaps, zone-based and journey analysis.

•   
Working knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization (Interaction Studio) and how Data Cloud segments feed website personalization.

•   
Solid grasp of experiment statistics: sample size and MDE, significance and confidence intervals, sample ratio mismatch, novelty effects, overlapping tests.

•   
Scrum fundamentals: you can run ceremonies, manage a backlog and unblock a team. CSM or PSM certification preferred.

•   
Clear written and verbal communication, able to turn data into a recommendation for non-technical stakeholders.

**Good to have**

•   
Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target or Salesforce certifications.

•   
Experience with consent-aware measurement and privacy-safe personalization (including India DPDP requirements).

•   
Familiarity with Core Web Vitals, tag management (Adobe Launch, GTM) and basic SQL or Python for ad-hoc analysis.

•   
Experience linking web leads to CRM or dealer outcomes (Salesforce, Data Cloud).

•   
Agency or consulting background with client-facing experience.

Ready to grow your career with an industry leader? Apply today—we’re excited to welcome you.
**#UatInsurity**
**What’s In It For U**

* Work Where You Thrive: Find a hybrid work environment that allows you to enjoy great work life balance, stay connected and collaborative
* Generous Time Off: Our leadership believes in taking the time you need when you need it.
* Day One Health Benefits + Employer-Matched Retirement Savings: You might think these are table stakes, but we know these matter to you.
* More Than Just Core Values: Our values are fundamental in how we attract, train, and retain top talent.
* Award-Winning Onboarding Program: We set you up from the get-go to make a significant impact from Day One and follow you through your entire first year.
* Real Career Growth Opportunities: We love to promote from within with over 25% of our open roles filled through internal applicants on average.

* Insurity Podcasts: Explore podcasts from our Learning & Development team for deeper insight into Insurity products, company innovation, and the business as a whole.
* Continuous Learning Opportunities: Own your development with your own LinkedIn Learning and Kaplan licenses.
* Employee Referral Bonus: Once you come onboard, give Insurity the biggest compliment you can give by referring someone to work here and earn a referral bonus.

**Insurity’s Next**
**Senior Support Engineer**
Insurity’s next Senior Support Engineer will be a hands-on, customer-focused technical support professional who owns and coordinates the investigation and resolution of medium- to high-complexity production issues across assigned Insurity products.
  
  
This role combines advanced ticket ownership and escalation judgment with product configuration, component and integration knowledge, technical troubleshooting, and functional and technical root-cause analysis. The ideal candidate communicates clearly, documents work accurately, mentors other support engineers and performs effective handoffs to help customers and internal teams reach timely resolutions.
  
  
This role is expected to work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours and support customer-facing production issues across applicable time zones when required
  
  
**What Our Senior Support Engineer**
**Will Do**

* Lead triage of incoming tickets, determine priority and ownership, identify billable work, and act as an escalation point for higher-priority or complex support issues.
* Own medium- to high-complexity customer issues and requests through investigation, coordination, communication, resolution, and documented closure.
* Use SQL or similar query tools, application and platform logs, troubleshooting tools, debugging utilities, and other diagnostic methods to investigate reported issues and validate findings.
* Use Kubernetes and GitOps workflows to monitor deployments, review operational behavior, and support investigation of production issues.
* Apply advanced product configuration knowledge to troubleshoot core components, workflows, business rules, transaction processing, and integrations.
* Use programming logic, such as PHP, C#, PowerBuilder, Angular, TypeScript, etc. knowledge to investigate defects, gather relevant evidence, and communicate findings for further resolution.
* Perform functional and technical root-cause analysis for complex incidents and present findings, impact, contributing factors, and recommended actions clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Perform technical troubleshooting across connected systems and identify whether an issue is caused by a defect, configuration gap, integration behavior, data condition, or support process.
* Execute or coordinate approved data-maintenance scripts, quality audits, and other support-related technical work with the appropriate teams.
* Escalate issues through established procedures, provide complete technical context, and maintain follow-up through resolution or transition to the appropriate owner.
* Maintain accurate ticket information, workflow systems, customer-facing tools, case records, resolution notes, impact assessments, and knowledge-based content with limited oversight.
* Support customer-facing production issues through clear written and verbal communication, coordination across multiple time zones, and effective handoffs that protect business continuity.
* Support new customer go-lives by following established readiness processes, completing assigned tasks, and coordinating risks or dependencies with the appropriate teams.
* Communicate with Product Management, Software Engineering, Professional Services, other internal teams, and third-party software suppliers or partners as needed.
* Provide self-service tool support and ad hoc training for customers, internal users, new employees, and other support team members.
* Mentor Support Engineers and provide practical guidance on troubleshooting, ticket ownership, documentation, escalation judgment, and customer communication.
* Support continuous-improvement initiatives that reduce low-value support demand, improve service quality, strengthen knowledge transfer, and increase customer self-service.
* Contribute to and improve knowledge-base articles, troubleshooting guides, standard procedures, and other documentation used for training and operational consistency.
* Use AI tools, where appropriate and consistent with company requirements, to support troubleshooting, research, analysis, and documentation.
* Stay current on industry and job-related trends, support best practices, Insurity product changes, and new products offered.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Who We’re Looking For**

* 4 to 7 years of experience in a support, development, or consulting environment, including at least 3 years supporting or developing assigned products.
* Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience.
* Experience owning complex customer issues, leading escalations, performing functional and technical root-cause analysis, and coordinating work across technical teams.
* Experience mentoring or providing technical guidance to less-experienced support engineers.
* Advanced analytical and critical-thinking skills, creative problem solving, and strong technical judgment.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings accurately, manage expectations, document work, and perform effective handoffs.
* Strong time-management, planning, prioritization, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and competing customer needs.
* Ability to collaborate effectively while also working independently and taking ownership of assigned work.
* Flexible and adaptable approach to customer and team support needs.
* Strong business and technical acumen, including software development acumen and programming logic.
* Advanced technical troubleshooting skills across applications, infrastructure, data, and integrations.
* Ability to configure the product and understand component and integration interactions.
* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office or similar productivity tools, SQL or similar query tools, XML/JSON or similar data formats, databases, version-control systems, case-management or CRM systems, debug utilities, application logs, and troubleshooting tools.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce and Jira, Kubernetes, GitOps workflows, web-based troubleshooting tools, and PHP-based defect investigation is preferred.
* Working knowledge of insurance workflows, supported business scenarios, customer variations, and Insurity products is preferred.
* Within the first three months, complete required Insurity Academy courses and product-specific training covering company learning requirements, insurance and domain concepts, product functions, workflow and process training, transaction workflows, and technical processing.
* Ability to travel approximately 0–10% as needed.

Thank you for your interest in Insurity! Please understand that due to the volume of applicants we receive, only selected candidates will be contacted.

ServiceNow ITAM,HAM,SAM ExpertiseTechnical Design & DeliveryCustomer & Team Leadership

* Team leadership: Set development standards, review the work of supporting developers, and coordinate across onsite/offshore team members.REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

Minimum two full-cycle HAM and/or SAM Pro implementations delivered end-to-end (design through hypercare). Candidates must be able to walk through these engagements in detail — scope, architecture, key design decisions, integration landscape, and lessons learned.

* CMDB/ITOM working knowledge: CSDM, Discovery data flows, and reconciliation — able to design HAM/SAM on top of a mature, live CMDB.
* Proven ability to lead independently: facilitate workshops, defend design positions, and manage customer technical stakeholders with minimal supervision.
* Strong verbal and written English, comfortable presenting to customer architects and program leadership.

CERTIFICATIONS
  
  

* Required: ServiceNow CSA; CIS–HAM and CIS–SAM (at least one; both strongly preferred).
* Preferred: CAD (Certified Application Developer), CIS–Discovery or CIS–ITSM; certifications current on recent platform releases.

NICE TO HAVE
  
  

* Experience delivering ITAM in financial services or public sector environments (audit/regulatory-driven SAM, vendor audits, true-ups).
* Exposure to SaaS License Management / license optimization initiatives.
* Familiarity with procurement/ERP integration patterns for asset intake.
* App Engine / custom scoped application delivery experience.

CANDIDATE ASSESSMENT
  
  
Shortlisted candidates will undergo a scenario-based technical assessment and should expect to:
  
  

* Present a prior HAM/SAM implementation — architecture, design decisions, integration landscape, and outcomes.
* Respond to live design scenarios — e.g., asset–CI reconciliation conflicts, license position discrepancies, normalization gaps.
* Demonstrate hands-on familiarity with SAM Pro reconciliation and HAM lifecycle configuration in a guided technical discussion.

Only candidates who can independently articulate and defend design decisions at this stage will be progressed.

description:

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.
  
  
Professional Services Consultant
  
  
Your Role
  
  
As our Cybersecurity Professional Services Consultant you will be responsible for deploying and implementing our data Security and protection solutions in customer enterprise environments. In this position, the consultant has a central role in the organisation, generating revenue in coordination with sales, interfacing with the customer, and coordinating with R&D and product management to enhance and optimise the solution to meet customer’s needs.
  
  

* Client Engagement & Implementation:
* In this role, you will be a trusted advisor, delivering high-quality consulting services and technical implementations that protect sensitive data and ensure compliance with security standards.

+ Lead technical implementations of Thales data security products and services (e.g., CipherTrust Data Security Platform, CipherTrust Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), Imperva Data Security Fabric, Hardware Security Modules (HSMs), Data Protection on Demand (DPoD), etc.)

* Conduct security assessments and data protection workshops with clients.
* Customize and configure data security solutions to meet client-specific requirements.
* Integrate security solutions with clients’ existing infrastructure (cloud, hybrid, on-prem).
* Solution Design & Architecture:
* Design scalable and secure architectures for data security solutions.
* Collaborate with pre-sales teams to understand customer needs and define technical scopes.
* Translate business and compliance requirements into technical controls and processes
* Delivery of customer engagements in the area of HSM, CipherTrust Data Security Platform, CipherTrust DSPM, SafeNet Trusted Access, and/or PKI
* Design – Role, Policies and Procedures
* Documentation and hands on deployment including hardware security modules
* Training & Support:
* Provide knowledge transfer and training to client security and IT teams.
* Offer post-deployment support and troubleshoot complex technical issues.
* Serve as a liaison between clients and product engineering teams for escalations and feedback.
* Documentation & Reporting:


+ Create detailed implementation documentation, security plans, and user guides.
+ Deliver executive-level and technical reports outlining project outcomes and recommendations.

**Your Experience**
This is a highly hands-on and technical role with extensive customer-facing responsibilities. You will work with cross-functional teams at customer sites, focusing mainly on IT security, data security, and data encryption and key management, to install and configure Thales data security products. To be successful in this role you will bring the following:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, professional services, or technical consulting
* Hands-on experience implementing Thales CipherTrust, HSM, or equivalent enterprise data security and encryption products

* Experience in database administration (mainly Oracle, MySQL, MS SQL, DB2, and/or Informix)

**Key Competencies:**

* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong client relationship and communication abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
* Passion for continuous learning in cybersecurity.

**Preferred:**

title: Senior Associate - Implementation Specialist
description:

**Position Summary**
****Transportation will be given by company****
The Sr. Associate – Implementation Specialist provides technical leadership and hands-on expertise across client implementations of apex portal™ and smartVM™. The role owns the technical success of an implementation end to end — from requirement discovery and solution design through ERP integration, data mapping, testing and go-live.
  
  
The successful candidate combines strong technical depth in SaaS platforms, APIs, ETL and databases with the consulting presence to build trusted client relationships. Practical, hands-on experience applying AI tools within a delivery or implementation environment is mandatory for this role. This is also a mentoring role: you will guide junior team members and act as an escalation point for complex technical issues.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
****Client Implementation & Delivery****
▪ Identify critical implementation requirements and build an implementation plan that delivers project milestones on time and to scope.
  
  
▪ Present technical overviews of apexportal and associated technical requirements to clients during implementation and upgrade planning.
  
  
▪ Manage the setup and configuration of the technical environment for hosted clients.
  
  
▪ Take end-to-end ownership of release and delivery activities, including cutover and post go-live stabilization.
  
  
****Solution Design & Integration****
▪ Design and develop workflows for apexportal functionality and present them to key stakeholders for sign-off.
  
  
▪ Assist clients in designing and building interfaces between their ERP systems and apexportal, and lead the testing of those integrations, including data reconciliation between the client ERP and apexportal.
  
  
▪ Develop and unit test baseline modules of the apexportal Solutions product.
  
  
▪ Apply AI tools and automation to accelerate delivery tasks such as data mapping, configuration, testing, documentation and issue diagnosis.
  
  
****Technical Leadership & Support****
▪ Serve as Subject Matter Expert and technical lead for client configurations and installations of apexportal and smartVM.
  
  
▪ Act as the escalation point for internal and external deployments, troubleshooting and diagnosing the root cause of software issues.
  
  
▪ Provide guidance, training and knowledge transfer to junior team members across both products.
  
  
▪ Partner with the Client Value and Audit teams to resolve client issues and support ongoing accounts.
  
  
****Process Improvement & Reporting****
▪ Design, implement and enhance high-impact business process improvement initiatives for client software implementations.
  
  
▪ Create and maintain mockups, BRDs, FRDs and wireframes using tools such as Visio, Excel, Microsoft Project, Adobe and Snagit.
  
  
▪ Provide recommendations to leadership on a regular and ad-hoc basis and prepare periodic status reporting for management.
  
  
**Required Skills & Experience**
**Candidates must demonstrate all of the following:**
▪
****AI experience —****
hands-on experience applying AI tools and technologies (for example AI-assisted development, automation, document or data extraction, or AI-supported analysis) to real delivery work. Candidates should be able to describe specific use cases and the outcome achieved.
  
  
▪
****Implementation / ERP background —****
4+ years in an implementation, technical consulting or professional services role, including exposure to ERP systems and their data structures.
  
  
▪
****SaaS product understanding —****
solid understanding of SaaS architecture, multi-tenant delivery models, configuration-led implementations and the release cycles they operate on.
  
  
▪
****APIs, ETL & data warehousing —****
working knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs, ETL mapping and table design, and core data warehouse concepts.
  
  
▪
****Database skills —****
hands-on experience with SQL Server, PostgreSQL or an equivalent relational database, including the ability to write and troubleshoot complex queries, stored procedures, views, indexes and jobs (2+ years).
  
  
▪
****Communication —****
excellent written and verbal communication, with the confidence to present technical concepts to non-technical client stakeholders and executives.
  
  
▪
****Delivery methodology —****
4+ years delivering within Agile / Scrum SDLC environments.
  
  
**Additional Technical Skills**
▪ Experience with Supply Chain or Procure-to-Pay technology implementations.
  
  
▪ Working knowledge of integration technologies including SSO, SAML, SSL, web services, REST and SOAP; ServiceNow integration experience is an advantage.
  
  
▪ Experience with version control tools such as Git, SVN, CVS or TFS.
  
  
▪ Familiarity with business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, QlikView or SSRS.
  
  
▪ Comfortable working with the command line and standard system commands.
  
  
**Preferred / Good To Have**
▪ Hands-on experience with Workday or Oracle.
  
  
▪ Consulting experience across multiple ERPs — specifically MDM, Vendor Master and P2P (SAP, Oracle, PeopleSoft and similar).
  
  
▪ Exposure to Accounts Payable modules within ERP systems such as Workday, SAP, Oracle or J.D. Edwards.
  
  
▪ Knowledge of report migration, subscriptions and data extraction from ERP systems.
  
  
▪ Experience defining application and system configuration standards with cross-functional teams and business units.
  
  
****CORE COMPETENCIES****
▪ Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with a track record of diagnosing root causes rather than symptoms.
  
  
▪ Client-service mindset, with the ability to translate client requirements into automated, scalable solutions.
  
  
▪ Highly organized and detail-oriented; able to multi-task with limited supervision and meet changing deadlines under pressure.
  
  
▪ Takes initiative and accepts accountability for outcomes.
  
  
▪ Collaborative and willing to share knowledge across the team.
  
  
**About Apexanalytix**
apexanalytix is a cloud-based software and services company that works with over 200 of the Global Fortune 1000 to recover lost profits, protect against procurement fraud, and manage supplier onboarding, compliance and payment profit optimization. Each year we receive approximately 9 million supplier records and $4.6 trillion in invoices and payments from our clients. We work with organizations including the world's largest retailer, electronics company, entertainment company, financial institutions, pharmaceutical and automotive manufacturers, and services companies, with shared services locations in the US, UK and Hong Kong.
  
  
Delivering our solutions to the world’s largest companies has enabled us to build what a leading IT industry analyst describes as possibly the only trusted source for accurate, high-value supplier information. We are making this data available to solution developers, enterprises and other organizations through an on-demand API business model. Our API service to the validated and enhanced smartVM data source is supplemented by over 400 real-time data sources through direct integration, subscription and robotics — giving clients the trusted data they need to ensure compliance, manage risk, improve B2B transaction processing, enable strategic initiatives, predict outcomes and prescribe action.

title: MQ Admin
description:
Job description:

Job Role – MQ Administrator

Position Title-MQ Administrator / Middleware Administrator

Location-As per project/business requirements

Salary: 50,000 to 70,000 Per Month

Experience-2-5

Employment Type-Full-Time

About the Company

We are a leading aviation IT solutions provider specializing in mission-critical airport systems integration, enterprise middleware, operational technology platforms, and digital transformation solutions for airports and aviation stakeholders. Our projects involve complex, high-availability environments requiring secure, scalable, and resilient system integrations across multiple airport operational systems.

We are seeking a highly skilled MQ Administrator to manage, optimize, and support enterprise messaging and middleware infrastructure in demanding, 24x7 operational environments.

Role Overview

The MQ Administrator will be responsible for the installation, configuration, administration, monitoring, troubleshooting, security, and performance optimization of enterprise messaging systems, primarily IBM MQ and related middleware technologies. The role requires strong expertise in high-availability messaging architecture, integration support, incident management, and coordination with application, infrastructure, cybersecurity, and operations teams.

The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical skills, operational discipline, proactive problem-solving capabilities, and the ability to work effectively in high-pressure, mission-critical aviation environments.

Key Responsibilities

Middleware & MQ Administration

* Install, configure, upgrade, patch, and maintain IBM MQ environments across development, testing, staging, and production systems.
* Create and manage Queue Managers, Queues, Channels, Listeners, Clusters, Topics, and security configurations.
* Configure and support distributed MQ environments across Linux, Windows, and cloud platforms.
* Manage MQ clustering, multi-instance queue managers, failover configurations, and high-availability setups.
* Perform routine health checks and preventive maintenance activities.
* Monitor queue depth, channel status, message flow, and overall middleware performance.
* Troubleshoot messaging failures, connectivity issues, latency problems, and application integration incidents.
* Support SSL/TLS configurations, certificate management, and secure messaging practices.
* Implement backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures for middleware environments.
* Maintain middleware standards, naming conventions, and operational procedures.



System Integration Support

* Coordinate with application teams, system integrators, OEM vendors, and infrastructure teams during deployments and integrations.
* Support airport operational systems integrations involving mission-critical applications.
* Assist in interface troubleshooting between enterprise systems, operational databases, APIs, and third-party applications.
* Analyze message flow logs and transaction traces for issue resolution.
* Support SIT, UAT, production rollout, and cutover activities.



Monitoring & Incident Management

* Provide L2/L3 support for production middleware incidents.
* Participate in 24x7 operational support and on-call rotations when required.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement corrective/preventive actions.
* Ensure compliance with SLA, availability, and operational KPIs.
* Maintain incident records, operational logs, and technical documentation.



Security & Compliance

* Ensure middleware infrastructure complies with organizational cybersecurity policies.
* Implement authentication, authorization, encryption, and audit logging mechanisms.
* Support vulnerability remediation, security audits, and compliance activities.
* Coordinate with cybersecurity teams for hardening and risk mitigation.



Automation & Optimization

* Develop and maintain automation scripts for monitoring, deployment, backup, and maintenance activities.
* Identify opportunities for performance tuning and operational improvements.
* Support infrastructure modernization and cloud migration initiatives where applicable.



Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience in IBM MQ Administration.
* Strong experience in enterprise middleware administration in production environments.
* Experience working on Linux and Windows server environments.
* Good understanding of TCP/IP, networking, firewall concepts, and secure communication protocols.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
* Experience with high-availability and disaster recovery configurations.
* Knowledge of shell scripting or automation scripting.
* Familiarity with ITIL-based incident and change management processes.



Preferred Skills

* Experience in aviation, airport systems, transportation, or mission-critical environments.
* Knowledge of IBM ACE/IIB, Kafka, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ, or other messaging platforms.
* Experience with containerized or cloud-based middleware deployments.
* Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, AppDynamics, Splunk, or similar.
* Understanding of APIs, REST/SOAP integrations, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Experience supporting large-scale system integration projects.
* Exposure to DevOps and CI/CD practices.

Desired Behavioral Competencies

* Strong ownership and accountability mindset.
* Ability to perform effectively under pressure in 24x7 operational environments.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills.
* High attention to detail and operational discipline.
* Proactive problem-solving approach.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional and multicultural teams.
* Strong documentation and reporting capabilities.
* Adaptability to evolving technologies and project requirements.

Working Conditions

* May require shift support and participation in on-call rotations.
* May involve support during production cutovers, migrations, and critical operational activities.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work on large-scale international aviation and airport technology projects.
* Exposure to mission-critical enterprise systems and integrations.
* Collaborative and technology-driven work environment.
* Career growth opportunities in enterprise integration and middleware technologies.
* Competitive compensation and professional development opportunities.

Application Process

Interested candidates may share their updated resume along with relevant project experience, certifications, and current notice period details.

Work Location: In person

description:
**Only candidates with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cognitive Science will be considered. Candidates with a degree in Psychology will not be considered for this role.** 




  





**About the role:** 




 We are looking for a Cognitive Science Expert to design engaging cognitive screening tasks, gamify assessments, develop intervention modules that support academic growth, and help refine and elevate our existing product.
 



  





**Qualification \& Experience** 




 MA/MSc in Cognitive Science or related field.
 



 4\+ years of experience in cognitive assessment design, neurocognitive research, or game\-based cognitive tasks.
 



 Experience with digital cognitive screening platforms, EdTech, HealthTech, serious games, or behavioral assessment systems preferred.
 



**Role Objective** 




 Lead the design and development of scientifically validated cognitive screening and gamified assessment frameworks to measure cognitive and behavioral parameters through multimodal interactions.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 Design and adapt cognitive assessment paradigms covering attention, memory, processing speed, executive functioning, decision\-making, cognitive flexibility, and social cognition.
 



 Develop game\-based cognitive screening tasks for children and adolescents.
 



 Define behavioral markers, scoring methodologies, and measurable variables from gameplay interactions. Conduct research, literature reviews, and validation studies to ensure reliability, sensitivity, specificity, and age normalization.
 



 Analyze behavioral data to identify cognitive markers and support pilot studies, usability testing, and research documentation.
 



**Required Skills** 




 Strong foundation in Cognitive Psychology, Neuropsychological Assessment, Experimental Design, and Psychometrics.
 



 Experience with paradigms such as Go/No\-Go, Stroop, N\-Back, CPT, Trail Making, Flanker, and Wisconsin Card Sorting.
 



 Proficiency in behavioral data analysis, cognitive scoring systems, and child cognitive profiling.
 



**Preferred Skills** 




 Experience in pediatric cognitive assessment and developmental psychology.
 



 Familiarity with neurodivergent populations, adaptive learning systems, and personalized interventions. Research publications or conference presentations are a plus.

**Tooling \& Visualization**
* Use Figma, and Blueworks Live to map current and future state journeys.

**Transformation Delivery \& Governance**

* Ensure alignment with BUK’s transformation governance, including floorwalk showcases.


**To be successful as a "**

* Tooling: Expert level proficiency in Figma (UI/UX design), Blueworks Live (process mapping) and MS Power point (presentation and storytelling)
* Translate complex operational challenges into simplified, scalable, and digitally enabled journeys.
* Drive high\-impact process optimization engagements that enhance efficiency, customer experience, and risk management.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate into actionable insights.
* Strong problem\-solving skills to identify pain points in the customer journey.

**Preferred Skills**

title: Product Design Intern
description:
🎨
 **Product Design Intern @ Neary 🫟** 




  





 Good design isn't the file you open in Figma first. It's the question you ask before you open Figma at all.
 



  





 Neary is a people\-first app for real\-world connection: no follower counts, no algorithm deciding who deserves your attention. Just proximity, honesty, and every screen we ship having to earn its place. We're looking for a designer who cares as much about
 *why* 
 as
 *what* 
 .
 



  





 This one's for a college student/part\-time consultant, who's hungry to design something real instead of another case study for a portfolio nobody asked for.
 



  





  





**👀 What you'll actually do** 



* Turn fuzzy "what if we..." ideas into flows that actually make sense
* Design in Figma daily, components, auto layout, prototypes people can actually click through
* Build and maintain our design system, themes, tokens, components that don't fall apart the third time someone reuses them
* Iterate fast. Ship a version, get roasted in feedback, fix it properly (not just patch it), move on
* Ask "wait, what problem are we solving here?" before you ask "what should this look like?"
* Keep your files clean. Future\-you, and the engineer picking it up, will thank you
* Sit with engineering and watch your design become a real, tappable thing
* Say "I don't think this is right" out loud, even to us. Especially to us.



  





  





**🛠️ What we hope you bring** 



* Real comfort in Figma, and genuine excitement to get better at it
* An eye for design systems and theming, consistency isn't boring, it's the whole game
* Speed without sloppiness: you iterate quickly and still land on the right fix, not just
 *a* 
 fix
* Product thinking: you notice
 *why* 
 an app feels good to use, not just how it looks
* The instinct to ask good questions before jumping to solutions
* Actual enthusiasm. We can teach skills. We can't teach whether you care.
* A team\-player streak, you take feedback without flinching, and give it kindly too
* Currently in college, third year preferred 🎓



  





  





**📌 The details** 



* Mode: Remote
* Hours: no more than 4 hours a day. This is exactly why college students fit best here, build alongside your semester, not instead of it
* When: no fixed hours. Work whenever you're in flow, mornings, midnights, whenever
* Duration: 8 weeks, extendable for the right person 🐥
* Team: a chill, young crew of 10\+, no hierarchy theatre, just people building
* Team meetups: once a month, entirely optional, snacks non\-negotiable 🥴



  





  





**🎁 What you'll walk away with** 



* Internship Certificate \+ Letter of Recommendation
* Real screens, shipped to real users, not filed away in a design system nobody opens
* Direct mentorship, not a "watch this Loom later" kind
* A portfolio piece with an actual story: the problem, the questions you asked, the thing you shipped



  





  





**💚 Who thrives here** 




 You get a small thrill from a clean file and a cleaner flow. You'd rather ask an awkward question in a meeting than guess quietly and be wrong later. You move fast, fix things right, and care about your team as much as your craft.
 



  





  





 If you read this and thought "wait, this sounds like me," hi. We'd love to see what you build. 🎨

title: Patch/Deployment Management
description:
**Req ID:** 
 373588
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a Patch/Deployment Management to join our team in Noida, Uttar Pradesh (IN\-UP), India (IN).
   

  

 Role Overview Patch Management \& Software Deployment is a senior hands\-on technical role within NTT DATA's Enterprise Endpoint Management (EPM) practice. This individual owns the design, execution, and continuous improvement of enterprise patch management and software deployment operations across Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) and Microsoft Intune for one or more enterprise client accounts.
   

  

 At Grade 9, the engineer operates with a high degree of independence on complex patching and deployment challenges, serves as the L3 escalation point for patch and software deployment issues within the team, and actively contributes to process governance, automation, and junior team development. The role is critical to client patch compliance posture, vulnerability remediation SLA adherence, and software lifecycle discipline across large, diverse endpoint estates.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Patch Management – SCCM / MECM**
* Design and govern the end\-to\-end software update management lifecycle in SCCM — from SUP synchronisation through ADR execution, deployment targeting, and compliance reporting.
* Architect and maintain WSUS topology — upstream/downstream server configuration, product and classification scoping, synchronisation schedules, and cleanup routines.
* Build and manage Automatic Deployment Rules (ADRs) for Patch Tuesday, out\-of\-band, and zero\-day update scenarios across tiered deployment ring strategies.
* Define and enforce maintenance window frameworks across server, workstation, and critical asset device collections aligned to client change management policies.
* Manage phased patch deployment pipelines — Pilot, UAT, and Production ring progressions with dwell periods and compliance gates.
* Monitor patch compliance dashboards and produce client\-facing SLA compliance reports; drive remediation for non\-compliant devices.
* Govern Software Update Point (SUP) health — synchronisation failures, WSUS certificate management, expired update cleanup, and IIS health monitoring.
* Manage third\-party patch management integration within SCCM where applicable — SCUP, or third\-party update catalogue publishing.
* Lead post\-patch validation activities — confirming deployment success, identifying failed devices, and driving re\-deployment or manual remediation workflows.


**Patch Management – Microsoft Intune / Windows Update for Business**
* Design and manage Windows Update for Business (WUfB) update ring policies in Intune for Quality Updates, Feature Updates, and driver update management.
* Configure and maintain Feature Update policies and Windows 11 readiness targeting for Intune\-managed device populations.
* Govern Intune update compliance reporting — identify deferred, failed, and non\-compliant devices and drive resolution within SLA.
* Manage Expedite Update workflows in Intune for emergency/zero\-day patch scenarios requiring accelerated deployment.
* Align Intune update ring configurations with SCCM co\-management patch workload authority assignments to prevent policy conflicts.
* Support Windows Autopatch readiness assessment and onboarding activities for eligible client environments.


**Software Deployment – SCCM / MECM**
* Lead application and software deployment design in SCCM — MSI, MSIX, EXE, and script\-based deployments with accurate detection rules, supersedence chains, and dependency modelling.
* Build and manage SCCM deployment types, requirement rules, and global conditions for complex multi\-platform application targeting.
* Design and govern phased deployment pipelines for critical software rollouts — piloting, staged production expansion, and rollback capability.
* Manage SCCM application catalogue health, deployment monitoring, and failed deployment investigation across client device estates.
* Govern SCCM Distribution Point (DP) content management — content pre\-staging, validation, redistribution, and bandwidth throttling for remote site deployments.
* Lead software lifecycle management within SCCM — application versioning, supersedence, retirement, and catalogue hygiene.
* Support Software Metering configuration for licence compliance monitoring and usage reporting.


**Software Deployment – Microsoft Intune**
* Build and manage Win32 application deployments in Intune — IntuneWinAppUtil packaging, detection rules, requirement rules, and dependency targeting.
* Manage LOB app, Microsoft Store for Business, and MSIX package deployments in Intune with appropriate assignment targeting.
* Govern app deployment monitoring and remediation — resolve installation failures, assignment conflicts, and detection rule mismatches.
* Manage Intune app supersedence and update workflows for deployed Win32 and LOB applications.
* Support PowerShell script and remediation deployment via Intune for configuration enforcement and break\-fix automation.


**Compliance Reporting \& Vulnerability Remediation**
* Produce and maintain patch compliance dashboards in SCCM SSRS, Power BI, or equivalent reporting tooling for client account review.
* Integrate patch compliance data with vulnerability management outputs (Qualys, Tenable, Defender Vulnerability Management) to drive prioritised remediation workflows.
* Maintain SLA compliance tracking for patch deployment targets — Critical, High, Medium, and Low severity update timelines.
* Lead monthly patch reporting packs for client QSR (Quarterly Service Review) inputs and governance reporting.
* Identify systemic compliance failures — analyse root causes (hardware, connectivity, agent health, exclusions) and drive permanent fixes.


**Automation \& Scripting**
* Develop and maintain PowerShell automation for SCCM patch operations — ADR management, collection membership, compliance queries, and remediation scripts.
* Build Microsoft Graph API integrations for Intune patch compliance reporting, update ring management, and bulk device operations.
* Automate WSUS maintenance routines — expired update decline, computer cleanup, and synchronisation health monitoring.
* Create PowerShell\-based deployment health check scripts for post\-patch and post\-deployment validation.


**Documentation, Governance \& Mentoring**
* Author and maintain patch management SOPs, runbooks, deployment playbooks, and maintenance window calendars.
* Represent patch and deployment changes in the client CAB (Change Advisory Board) process — RFC preparation and impact assessment.
* Provide L3 technical guidance and mentoring to Grade 7 and Grade 8 engineers on patch and software deployment operations.
* Conduct peer reviews of deployment configurations, ADR setups, and compliance reporting produced by junior team members.
* Contribute to EPM practice knowledge base, lessons learned documentation, and internal technical communities.


**Required Skills**
**SCCM / MECM – Patch \& Deployment**
* SCCM Current Branch – Software Update Management: SUP, WSUS, ADR, Maintenance Windows, Phased Deployments (advanced level)
* Application deployment – MSI/MSIX/EXE, detection rules, supersedence, dependency modelling, phased rollout
* Distribution Point management – content prestaging, bandwidth throttling, remote DP operations
* SCCM reporting – SSRS built\-in reports, custom compliance queries, WQL collection queries
* Third\-party patch integration – SCUP or third\-party catalogue publishing experience (desirable)
* Co\-management – patch workload authority, Intune/SCCM policy conflict avoidance


**Microsoft Intune – Patch \& Deployment**
* Windows Update for Business (WUfB) – update rings, Feature Update policies, driver management, expedite workflows
* Win32 app packaging and deployment – IntuneWinAppUtil, detection rules, requirement rules, dependency
* Intune compliance and update reporting – built\-in reports, Graph API\-based custom reporting
* Remediation scripts and PowerShell deployment via Intune
* Intune co\-management alignment – patch workload and policy authority coordination with SCCM


**Vulnerability \& Compliance Integration**
* Integration of patch compliance with vulnerability management tools – Qualys VMDR, Tenable, or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management
* SLA\-based patch compliance tracking and executive reporting
* Power BI or SSRS for patch compliance dashboard development


**Scripting \& Automation**
* PowerShell – advanced scripting for SCCM patch operations, WSUS maintenance, Intune automation
* Microsoft Graph API – Intune patch compliance, update ring management, bulk device operations
* WMI/CIM – SCCM device collection queries, patch state interrogation


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD\-102\) – held or in progress
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ\-104\)
* ITIL v4 Foundation
* Experience with Windows Autopatch assessment and onboarding
* Familiarity with SCCM CMG (Cloud Management Gateway) for internet\-based patch management
* Exposure to Qualys VMDR, Tenable.io, or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management integration with SCCM/Intune
* Prior experience delivering patch compliance in regulated environments — ISO 27001, HIPAA, SOX, or PCI\-DSS


 Experience Profile
   

  

* 9–12 years of progressive experience in enterprise endpoint management.
* Minimum 5 years of hands\-on SCCM/MECM Software Update Management and application deployment experience.
* Minimum 2 years of Microsoft Intune WUfB and Win32 application deployment experience.
* Proven track record managing patch compliance across multi\-site enterprise estates of 5,000\+ endpoints.
* Experience working in managed services, IT outsourcing, or large enterprise IT delivery models preferred.


 Minimum Education
   

  

* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline.
* MCA or equivalent postgraduate qualification considered with commensurate experience.

We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. **Role Overview**
 We are seeking experienced and hands\-on Senior Infrastructure Automation Engineers (DevSecOps) with strong proficiency in Azure and Kubernetes to design, provision, automate, secure, and support scalable multicloud infrastructure for enterprise workloads.
   

  

 The role requires deep expertise in Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, container orchestration on Kubernetes, automated CI/CD pipeline engineering, Python\-based infrastructure automation, and embedding security controls across the build, deploy, and run lifecycle, with a strong focus on reliability, compliance, cost\-awareness, and delivery quality.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, provision, and manage scalable multicloud infrastructure with Azure as the primary platform and AWS as the secondary platform.
* Architect and operate production\-grade Kubernetes clusters (AKS / EKS / self\-managed) covering deployments, scaling, networking, ingress, secrets, RBAC, upgrades, and operational troubleshooting.
* Implement and govern Infrastructure as Code using Terraform — module design, remote state, workspaces, policy\-as\-code, and reusable platform components for repeatable, secure, and auditable deployments.
* Build, maintain, and optimize end\-to\-end CI/CD pipelines for application and infrastructure delivery, including build, test, scan, approval, and progressive deployment workflows.
* Develop Python\-based automation, tooling, and operators to streamline provisioning, configuration, remediation, and day\-2 operations across cloud platforms.
* Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC — SAST, DAST, SCA, container image scanning, IaC scanning, secrets management, and policy\-as\-code (OPA / Sentinel / Kyverno).
* Integrate cloud infrastructure with enterprise networking, IAM, security, monitoring, logging, and DevOps toolchains in line with enterprise standards.
* Monitor platform health, lead incident response, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous service and reliability improvements.
* Ensure infrastructure is resilient, secure, compliant, cost\-aware, and aligned with enterprise architecture, security baselines, and operational standards.
* Mentor junior engineers, lead technical reviews, and contribute to platform engineering standards, runbooks, and reference architectures.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* 6\+ years of overall experience in cloud infrastructure engineering, DevOps, DevSecOps, or platform engineering, with at least 3\+ years in a senior or lead capacity.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Azure services (AKS, VNet, Azure AD / Entra ID, Key Vault, Storage, Monitor, Policy, Azure DevOps); working knowledge of AWS services (EKS, EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, CloudWatch) as the secondary platform.
* Deep, production\-grade experience with Kubernetes and the broader container ecosystem (Docker, Helm, Istio / service mesh, ingress controllers, operators).
* Strong expertise in Terraform — module development, state management, multi\-environment patterns, and integration with policy\-as\-code frameworks.
* Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent, including pipeline security and supply\-chain controls.
* Strong proficiency in Python for infrastructure automation, tooling, and integration; working knowledge of Bash / Shell scripting.
* Solid grounding in cloud security — IAM, network segmentation, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management, and DevSecOps tooling (e.g., Trivy, Checkov, tfsec, SonarQube, Snyk, Aqua / Prisma Cloud).
* Good understanding of cloud networking, hybrid connectivity, load balancing, observability, logging, and access controls.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues, deployment failures, distributed systems, and performance bottlenecks.
* Strong awareness of cloud governance, compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS Benchmarks), cost optimization, and operational best practices.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, documentation, collaboration, and stakeholder communication skills.


**Qualification and Certifications**
* B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* One or more relevant certifications strongly preferred — Microsoft Azure (AZ\-104 / AZ\-305 / AZ\-400\), CKA / CKAD / CKS, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, AWS Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer, or recognized security certifications (CCSK, CompTIA Security\+).
* Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying current with cloud, DevSecOps, Kubernetes, and platform engineering practices.


**Good\-to\-Have Skills**
* Exposure to GCP and broader multi\-cloud operating models.
* Experience with policy\-as\-code and guardrails (OPA / Gatekeeper, Kyverno, Azure Policy, Sentinel).
* Experience with service mesh, GitOps tooling (ArgoCD, Flux), and progressive delivery patterns.
* Experience with monitoring and observability stacks such as Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, ELK, Datadog, or Dynatrace.
* Experience with Azure Cost Management, AWS Cost Explorer, tagging strategies, and FinOps practices.
* Exposure to platform engineering, internal developer platforms (IDP), release management, and SRE practices.


**Working Expectations**
* Collaborate effectively with architecture, engineering, security, application, and operations teams across geographies.
* Maintain clear, version\-controlled documentation for infrastructure design, deployment steps, SOPs, runbooks, and automation scripts.
* Demonstrate strong ownership in resolving issues, improving reliability, hardening security posture, and enhancing automation across cloud platforms.
* Follow enterprise delivery standards, security controls, change and operational procedures, and quality expectations.
* Provide technical mentorship and act as an escalation point for complex infrastructure, automation, and security challenges.

**What You'll Do** 



*

title: Sr CRM Administration - HubSpot
description:
The Senior CRM Administrator is responsible for the overall operation of the Hubspot CRM platform. This position provides technical direction on configuration and maintenance, resolves production issues, and leads root cause analysis to identify and implement long\-term solutions. The Senior Salesforce Administrator partners with both business and technical teams to prototype and deliver application solutions with respect to value, quality, information security and end\-user experience and works with 3rd party resources to ensure that Salesforce\-based projects are implemented according to best practices.
   

  

 Sr CRM Administration (India) \- HubSpot
   

  

**Remote, India**
 The Senior CRM Administrator is responsible for the overall operation of the Hubspot CRM platform. This position provides technical direction on configuration and maintenance, resolves production issues, and leads root cause analysis to identify and implement long\-term solutions. The Senior Salesforce Administrator partners with both business and technical teams to prototype and deliver application solutions with respect to value, quality, information security and end\-user experience and works with 3rd party resources to ensure that Salesforce\-based projects are implemented according to best practices.
   

  

**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**
* Administer, configure, and optimize HubSpot, including objects, properties, pipelines, lifecycle stages, workflows, automation, forms, lists, permissions, reporting, dashboards, templates, and other platform capabilities.
* Partner with sales, marketing, service, operations, and other business stakeholders to understand business processes, identify opportunities for improvement, and translate requirements into practical CRM solutions.
* Champion CRM data governance by establishing and maintaining system guardrails, security controls, naming conventions, documentation, and operating procedures that promote accurate and consistent data.
* Perform data imports, exports, cleansing, deduplication, transformation, and routine maintenance to support business operations, integrations, reporting, and data quality objectives.
* Develop and maintain a strong understanding of related business applications, integrations, and data flows in order to identify risks, resolve issues, and recommend improvements.
* Support CRM integrations and plugins, including requirements definition, field mapping, testing, monitoring, troubleshooting, and coordination with technical teams and vendors.
* Own the overall health, stability, usability, and performance of the CRM environment by proactively identifying technical debt, process inefficiencies, adoption issues, and opportunities for automation.
* Leverage custom code and development when appropriate to extend platform capabilities and deliver reliable solutions. Partner with developers or third\-party resources when specialized development is required.
* Own the CRM enhancement intake process for assigned work by gathering, evaluating, documenting, prioritizing, and implementing requests, defects, and continuous\-improvement opportunities.
* Participate in backlog review, story refinement, sprint planning, testing, deployment, and completion of assigned work within agile delivery cycles.
* Plan for, test, and communicate the impact of HubSpot, Salesforce, Amazon Voice/Amazon Connect, and related application releases and changes.
* Organize and support POC’s, solution demonstrations, user acceptance reviews, and end\-user validation for CRM enhancements.
* Perform root\-cause analysis for production issues and implement sustainable corrective actions rather than relying only on short\-term fixes.
* Partner with technical leads and vendors on solution design, implementation planning, integration design, and other technical artifacts.
* Maintain complete and accurate technical and end\-user documentation for system configuration, workflows, integrations, data flows, support procedures, and release changes.
* Provide user support, troubleshooting, enablement, and informal coaching to help business users adopt CRM capabilities and follow established processes.
* Support the administration and optimization of Salesforce, Amazon Connect and related business applications as part of the broader CRM ecosystem.


**Required Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in CRM administration, business applications administration, or a related systems role.
* Minimum of 3 years of hands\-on experience administering HubSpot in a complex business environment.
* Proven experience configuring and supporting HubSpot capabilities, including objects, properties, pipelines, workflows, automation, permissions, reporting, dashboards, and data management.
* Proven track record of managing complex projects.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and negotiation skills.
* Familiarity with agile methodologies and project management tools.
* CRM\-related certifications a plus (e.g., Salesforce Administrator).


**Required Skills**
* Deep practical expertise administering HubSpot, with the judgment to design scalable solutions that balance business value, usability, data quality, security, and maintainability.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to investigate root causes and objectively prioritize competing requests.
* Ability to assess when no\-code or low\-code configuration is appropriate and when custom development, APIs, or technical specialists are needed.
* Strong communication and customer\-partnership skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders and derive clear requirements and priorities.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and drive work to completion with minimal direction.
* Exceptional organization and time\-management skills in a fast\-paced, changing environment with competing priorities and ambiguity.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with business stakeholders, technical teams, vendors, and managed service providers without direct supervisory responsibility.
* Ability to respond calmly and professionally to difficult situations and production incidents.
* Ability to create and maintain clear procedures, support materials, technical documentation, and end\-user guidance.
* Ability to administer and support Salesforce as a secondary CRM platform and understand how its configuration and data interact with the broader CRM ecosystem.
* Strong customer and partner focus, with a commitment to improving user experience and business outcomes.
* Ability and willingness to help others learn and effectively use enterprise applications.
* High standards of ethics, professionalism, accountability, and data stewardship.


**Preferred Skills**
* Salesforce CRM (Sales, Service, CPQ, Marketing)
* Amazon Voice

**DEM (Digital Experience Management) Analyst**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* The DEM Analyst is responsible for proactively analysing the digital experience of end users and identifying potential areas for improvement within End User Experience Management technologies, such as Nexthink, Lakeside Systrack, and Aternity, as part of the End User Analytics Services that Fujitsu provides to our customers.
* As the DEM Analyst, you will focus on analysing the digital experience scores on a proactive basis and providing reports to account team stakeholders on the key issues that are causing drops in digital experience and recommendations for improvement areas.
* You will also conduct deeper investigations with support from relevant resolver groups, utilizing the DEM tool and other key service performance data, such as ticket analysis, to understand the breadth and impact of the issue.
* You will oversee the implementation of any new requirements from improvement recommendations and are responsible for reporting the status and benefits of these improvements.
* Continuous learning is an important part of this role and you will be expected to participate in learning sessions and reading facilitated by our vendor partners or the Centre of Excellence (aka DEM Dojo) use cases and best practices.
* It is expected that the role owner will have a close relationship with the Digital Advisor and the CEC Digital Adoption \& UX Lead.
* The Digital Advisor is an additional advisory role who is deployed on a project\-basis that will be responsible for defining and shaping the digital experience score and XLAs and will also identify the first set of improvement opportunities and recommendations.
* You will be expected to continue the work of the Digital Advisor once the service is in a steady state and work through the improvement backlog or identify new opportunity areas.
* This continuation also includes working closely with the CEC Digital Adoption \& UX Lead to create a complete picture of user experience, with your focus being on technology\-level experience and the DA \& UX Lead focusing on service\-level experience.
* The DA \& UX Lead will be a key stakeholder in providing requirements for any use cases that involved contact with end users. You will be responsible for managing the requirements for any new use cases identified as part of the improvement plan, working with the DEM Business Analyst and DEM Technician to ensure successful delivery of these requirements.
* You will play a key role in progressing the service along the maturity roadmap to ensure it brings tangible business benefits. Where there is no Digital Advisor allocated to the account, the role will involve a period of transition to support the baselining and configuration of the digital experience score, based on requirements from the customer and account team, and the initial set of recommendations for improvement areas based on use cases and best practices from the DEM Dojo.
* The role should follow the ITIL Service Value System Principles Focus on value Start where you are Progress iteratively with feedback Collaborate and promote visibility

* Decreased MTTR of Fujitsu managed services resolver groups by educating them on using DEM technologies to resolve issues and through the implementation of their use case and dashboard requirements
* The exploitation of the DEM technologies to drive account ROI and transformation of roles towards proactive continuous improvement Increased end user digital experience scores tied into outcome\-based CI Successful launch and program activity, minimize delays Meet contractual KSVI commitments Customer renewals / good news stories and references
* Supporting the CI Service Delivery Manager to drive change and improvements Maturity assessment benefits realization / understand customer journey mapping Required


**Experience**

**Role Summary**
 We are looking for an AI \- IT/OT Network \& Infrastructure Security – Manager to act as the technical owner for client\-facing network \& Infrastructure Security transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a hands\-on manager who can move from discovery to design to deployment, embedding closely with clients to architect and implement high\-impact solutions while leading engineering teams and shaping deals. Your internal role matrix positions this level as the next step beyond just delivery, but architecting solutions at the intersection of platforms and AI tools (agents and models).
   

  

 This role is part of the Cyber Frontier \& AI capability focused on enabling scalable, AI\-first cyber defense across enterprise and industrial environments.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise, cloud, and OT environments.
* Drive adoption of Zero Trust, IEC 62443\-aligned OT security controls, and advanced segmentation architectures.
* Oversee deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE,DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.

* Utilize AI/ML for network threat detection, including intrusion detection, lateral movement analysis, and zero\-day attack identification in IT/OT environments.
* Design and optimize prompt engineering strategies to effectively leverage GenAI tools for IT/OT security use cases such as incident investigation, log analysis, and threat intelligence enrichment.
* Enable AI\-driven continuous monitoring and predictive risk analytics to enhance IT/OT resilience and reduce operational downtime.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s AI Network \& Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 8–12 years of experience across AI driven Network \& Infrastructure security domain, Security architecture, OT security, Zero Trust Security, or related fields.
* Experience with OT security tools (Nozomi, Claroty, Armis, Dragos, Cisco Cyber Vision) and OT vulnerability management.
* Expertise in XDR, Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (IEC 62443, CIS). Hands\-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* Skilled in SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
* Strong capability in multi\-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.
* Strong client\-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Good soft skills i.e. verbal \& written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong project management, negotiation and interpersonal skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Customer orientation skills
* Industry related certification (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, SABSA, PRINCE2, TOGAF)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Nozomi, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco \& others)


**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect their network \& infra structure security portfolio in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of IT/OT Network , Infrastructure security, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the network \& infrastructure security practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.

* Work effectively within a team distributed across multiple geographic locations



  





**Good to Have** 




  




* ITIL v3 or ITIL Service Operation knowledge/certification
* Exposure to cloud DR/backup services (AWS Backup, Azure Site Recovery, or equivalent)
* Experience with SharePoint site administration/configuration beyond basic content updates
* Ability to support a 24x7 operational environment, including occasional weekend or off\-hours work as required
* Enjoys working in a fast\-paced environment and learning new tools/technologies

You will work closely with colleagues across Editorial, Marketing, Customer Services, and external technology partners, helping to deliver high\-quality digital solutions that support OUP's mission of advancing knowledge and learning.
 



 The role offers exposure to product management, agile delivery, digital content management, quality assurance, customer\-focused product enhancements, and educational technology.  Key responsibilities include:

title: Growth Strategy Analyst - Market Research & Intelligence
description:
**Job Summary:** 




  





 We are looking for a GTM Analyst \- Market Research \& Insights (5 \- 10 years) to support our GTM, presales and bid teams with structured market, customer and competitive insights for RFPs, proactive proposals and go\-to\-market initiatives. The role sits within the presales team and works closely with Business Unit Heads, competency owners, solution architects, sales and senior management to sharpen GTM strategies and deal positioning.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




  





 \- Conduct secondary research on target accounts, industries and geographies to provide context, trends and benchmarks for RFPs, proposals and GTM plans.
 



  





 \- Build and maintain competitor profiles: offerings, positioning, pricing signals, win themes, differentiators and recent deals relevant to our GTM focus areas.
 



  





 \- Analyse RFPs/RFIs to extract business drivers, buying criteria and implicit needs, and map them to our GTM strategy and value propositions.
 



  





 \- Create insight packs for pursuits: market snapshots, customer landscape, stakeholder maps, SWOT, buyer personas, typical decision process and GTM implications.
 



  





 \- Support presales and sales with quantitative analysis: market sizing, opportunity assessment, TAM/SAM/SOM, basic financial and pricing analysis.
 



  





 \- Work with solution architects and sales to refine win themes, value propositions and proof points based on market and competitive intelligence.
 



  





 \- Draft data\-backed content for proposals, GTM presentations and sales collateral: industry trends, business case inputs, ROI models, benchmark data (using public sources or internal case studies).
 



  





 \- Maintain reusable GTM knowledge assets: sector playbooks, battle cards, case study libraries, standard statistics and reference data.
 



  





 \- Track and report on deal outcomes to derive patterns on why we win/lose; feed insights back into future bids and GTM strategies.
 



  





 \- Collaborate with marketing to align thought leadership, campaigns and sales collateral with deal\-level and GTM insights.
 



  





 \- Ensure all research follows compliance, confidentiality and citation standards.
 



  





**Requirements:** 




  





 \- 3 \- 6 years of experience in market research, consulting, business analysis, or strategy roles, preferably in IT/technology services or SaaS.
 



  





 \- Demonstrated experience in desk research, competitive analysis, and synthesising insights into executive\-ready outputs (slides, briefs, notes).
 



  





 \- Exposure to proposal processes; understanding of enterprise sales cycles and GTM motions is a strong plus.
 



  





 \- Experience working with cross\-functional teams (sales, presales, delivery, marketing, finance).
 



  





**Skills and competencies:** 




  





 \- Strong research and analytical skills; ability to work with both qualitative and quantitative data.
 



  





 \- Excellent business writing and storytelling skills; able to convert analysis into clear narratives and visuals.
 



  





 \- Good understanding of technology and digital/IT services landscape (cloud, data, apps, integrations, etc.) or willingness to ramp up quickly.
 



  





 \- Proficiency with Excel/Sheets (models, basic analytics) and PowerPoint/Slides (storyboarding, visualisation).
 



  





 \- Familiarity with research and intelligence tools (e.g., LinkedIn, company databases, industry reports); experience with any paid intel tools is a plus.
 



  





 \- High attention to detail, strong organisation and ability to support multiple bids and GTM initiatives in parallel under tight timelines.
 



  





 \- Stakeholder management skills; comfortable working closely with senior sales leaders and SMEs.
 



  





**Education:** 




  





 \- Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, IT, or related field.
 



  





 \- MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is a plus but not mandatory.
 



  





**Why This Role Is Attractive:** 




  





 \- Direct impact on deal wins and business growth by shaping the insights, GTM narratives and positioning that influence our most strategic pursuits.
 



  





 \- Opportunity to build a foundational presales and GTM intelligence capability for TTN, including reusable assets, win\-loss insights, and data\-driven decision frameworks for leadership.
 



  





 \- Steep learning curve across diverse industries, technologies and GTM strategies, giving you broad exposure and accelerated professional growth.
 



  





 \- Strong visibility with sales leadership, Business Unit Heads, solution architects and marketing, opening up future paths into sales leadership, business consulting, account management or practice roles.

* A strong portfolio of UX Design work.
